qEn: Ajanta Caves, known for ancient rock-cut Buddhist monuments, are located in which state?
qHi: प्राचीन रॉक-कट बौद्ध स्मारकों के लिए प्रसिद्ध अजंता गुफाएँ किस राज्य में स्थित हैं?
explainEn: The Ajanta Caves are approximately 30 rock-cut Buddhist cave monuments dating from the 2nd century BCE to about 480 CE in Aurangabad district (now Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar) of Maharashtra.

qEn: The headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India is located in which city?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक का मुख्यालय किस शहर में स्थित है?
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India was established in 1935 and its central office is located in Mumbai.
sourceHint: Reserve Bank of India Official Website

qEn: Which of the following dynasties constructed the famous Brihadisvara Temple at Thanjavur?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस राजवंश ने तंजावुर में प्रसिद्ध बृहदेश्वर मंदिर का निर्माण कराया था?
explainEn: The Brihadisvara Temple in Thanjavur was built by Raja Raja Chola I of the Chola dynasty in the 11th century.

qEn: What is the minimum age required to become a member of the Lok Sabha in India?
qHi: भारत में लोकसभा का सदस्य बनने के लिए न्यूनतम आयु कितनी आवश्यक है?
explainEn: Article 84 of the Constitution specifies 25 years as the minimum age for a Lok Sabha member.

qEn: Which vitamin is primarily obtained from sunlight exposure by the human body?
qHi: मानव शरीर द्वारा मुख्य रूप से धूप के संपर्क में आने से कौन सा विटामिन प्राप्त होता है?
explainEn: Vitamin D is produced in the skin when exposed to ultraviolet B sunlight.

qEn: Which plateau lies between the Aravalli and the Vindhya ranges?
qHi: अरावली और विंध्य श्रेणियों के बीच कौन सा पठार स्थित है?
explainEn: The Malwa Plateau is bounded by the Central Highlands in the north, the Aravalli range in the west, and the Vindhya range in the south.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the officers in charge of the royal treasury were typically referred to by which term?
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, शाही खजाने के प्रभारी अधिकारियों को आमतौर पर किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
explainEn: In the administrative system of the Gupta period, Bhandagariyakrta was the officer responsible for the royal treasury.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution directs the State to organize Village Panchayats?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राज्य को ग्राम पंचायतों के संगठन का निर्देश देता है?
explainEn: Article 40 of the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) lays down that the State shall take steps to organize village panchayats.

qEn: The Dhuandhar Falls are formed by which river in Madhya Pradesh?
qHi: मध्य प्रदेश में धुआँधार जलप्रपात किस नदी द्वारा बनाया जाता है?
explainEn: The Dhuandhar Falls is located on the Narmada River in Bhedaghat, Madhya Pradesh, where the river plunges and creates a mist of water droplets.

qEn: Which vitamin deficiency causes beriberi?
qHi: किस विटामिन की कमी से बेरीबेरी रोग होता है?
explainEn: Beriberi is a disease caused by a vitamin B1 (thiamine) deficiency, affecting the cardiovascular and nervous systems.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 6 Science, Chapter 2 Components of Food

qEn: Who was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty according to the Puranas and inscriptions?
qHi: पुराणों और अभिलेखों के अनुसार सातवाहन वंश का संस्थापक कौन था?
explainEn: Simukha is mentioned in the inscriptions and Puranas as the founder of the Satavahana dynasty.
sourceHint: Tamil Nadu State Board History Textbook for Class 11

qEn: The famous monument Qutb Minar is located in which Indian city?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध स्मारक कुतुब मीनार किस भारतीय शहर में स्थित है?
explainEn: Qutb Minar is a minaret and victory tower located in the Mehrauli area of South Delhi.

qEn: Which river originates from the Gangotri Glacier in Uttarakhand?
qHi: उत्तराखंड में गंगोत्री ग्लेशियर से कौन सी नदी निकलती है?
explainEn: The Ganga river originates as the Bhagirathi from the Gangotri Glacier in Uttarakhand.

qEn: Kathakali is a classical dance form that originated in which Indian state?
qHi: कथकली एक शास्त्रीय नृत्य रूप है जिसकी उत्पत्ति किस भारतीय राज्य में हुई थी?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance characterized by its elaborate make-up and costumes, originating in Kerala.

qEn: Which vitamin is primarily responsible for blood clotting?
qHi: कौन सा विटामिन मुख्य रूप से रक्त का थक्का जमाने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Vitamin K plays a major role in blood clotting, helping the body heal wounds properly.

qEn: Which of the following folk dances is traditionally associated with the state of Assam?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा लोक नृत्य पारंपरिक रूप से असम राज्य से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Bihu is an indigenous folk dance from Assam associated with the Bihu festivals.
sourceHint: Centre for Cultural Resources and Training (CCRT)

qEn: The famous Kaziranga National Park is primarily known for the conservation of which animal?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान मुख्य रूप से किस जानवर के संरक्षण के लिए जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Kaziranga National Park in Assam hosts two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses.

qHi: साधारण नमक का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Common salt is ionic compound sodium chloride, represented by the chemical formula NaCl.

qEn: Which river basin is the Bhakra Nangal Dam built on?
qHi: भाखड़ा नांगल बांध किस नदी बेसिन पर बनाया गया है?
explainEn: The Bhakra Nangal Dam is a concrete gravity dam on the Sutlej River in Himachal Pradesh.

qEn: Which battle marked the virtual foundation of the Mughal empire in India?
qHi: किस युद्ध ने भारत में मुगल साम्राज्य की वास्तविक नींव रखी?
explainEn: The First Battle of Panipat in 1526, won by Babur over Ibrahim Lodi, led to the establishment of the Mughal Empire in India.

qHi: एलोरा का प्रसिद्ध चट्टान-क,ट कैलाश मंदिर किस राजवंश के संरक्षण में बनाया गया था?
explainEn: The Kailasa Temple (Cave 16) at Ellora was commissioned by the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I in the 8th century.

qEn: Which metal is commonly known as quicksilver?

explainEn: Mercury is historically referred to as quicksilver because it is a liquid metal that flows like a liquid yet has the silvery appearance of a metal.

qEn: In which physiographic division of India is the Karewa formation primarily found?
qHi: भारत के किस भौतिक भूभाग में करेवा संरचना मुख्य रूप से पाई जाती है?
explainEn: Karewas are thick deposits of glacial clay and other materials embedded with moraines, found notably in the Kashmir Himalayas, famous for saffron cultivation.

qEn: Which committee recommended the establishment of the NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development)?
qHi: किस समिति ने नाबार्ड (राष्ट्रीय कृषि और ग्रामीण विकास बैंक) की स्थापना की सिफारिश की थी?
explainEn: NABARD was established on July 12, 1982, on the recommendations of the Committee to Review Arrangements for Institutional Credit for Agriculture and Rural Development (B. Sivaraman Committee).

qEn: Which of the following elements has the highest electron affinity in the periodic table?
qHi: आवर्त सारणी में निम्नलिखित में से किस तत्व की इलेक्ट्रॉन बंधुता सबसे अधिक है?
explainEn: Chlorine has the highest electron gain enthalpy (electron affinity) in the periodic table, slightly higher than fluorine due to electron-electron repulsion in the smaller 2p orbitals of fluorine.

qEn: Who among the following was the founder of the independent kingdom of Awadh in the 18th century?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 18वीं शताब्दी में अवध के स्वतंत्र राज्य का संस्थापक था?
explainEn: Saadat Khan, also known as Burhan-ul-Mulk, founded the autonomous state of Awadh in 1722 after the decline of Mughal authority.

qEn: What is the primary function of the 'Aoidoi' or 'Rhapsodes' in ancient Greek history, analogous to which class in ancient Indian tradition?
qHi: प्राचीन यूनानी इतिहास में 'ऑइडोई' या 'रैप्सोड्स' का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या था, जो प्राचीन भारतीय परंपरा में किस वर्ग के समरूप है?
explainEn: Aoidoi and Rhapsodes were ancient Greek bards and reciters of epic poetry, functioning similarly to the traditional court bards, chroniclers, and genealogists known as Sutas and Magadhas in ancient India.
sourceHint: Ancient World History texts and NCERT themes

qEn: Which biogeochemical cycle does not have a gaseous phase in its circulation through the atmosphere?
qHi: किस जैव-भू-रासायनिक चक्र में वायुमंडल के माध्यम से इसके संचलन में गैसीय चरण नहीं होता है?
explainEn: Phosphorus is a sedimentary cycle and does not have a significant gaseous phase in the atmosphere, unlike carbon, nitrogen, and sulphur.

qEn: Which vitamin is primarily responsible for the clotting of human blood?
qHi: मानव रक्त के थक्के जमने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा विटामिन जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Vitamin K plays a major role in blood clotting, preventing excessive bleeding.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional folk festival celebrated in which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू किस भारतीय राज्य में मनाया जाने वाला एक पारंपरिक लोक त्योहार है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three important cultural festivals of Assam.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of the Finance Commission of India?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद भारत के वित्त आयोग की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 280 of the Constitution of India provides for a Finance Commission as a quasi-judicial body constituted by the President of India.

qEn: Who was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty in ancient India?
qHi: प्राचीन भारत में सातवाहन वंश का संस्थापक कौन था?
explainEn: Simukha was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty, which ruled parts of central and southern India from the 1st century BCE onwards.

qEn: Which chemical element has the highest electrical conductivity at room temperature among all naturally occurring elements?
qHi: सभी प्राकृतिक रूप से पाए जाने वाले तत्वों में से कमरे के तापमान पर किस रासायनिक तत्व की विद्युत चालकता सबसे अधिक होती है?
explainEn: Silver has the highest electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, and reflectivity of any metal.

qEn: Which of the following winds is a hot, dry, and local wind that blows in the northern plains of India during the summer season?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी हवा एक गर्म, शुष्क और स्थानीय हवा है जो गर्मियों के मौसम में भारत के उत्तरी मैदानों में चलती है?
explainEn: Loo is a strong, dusty, gusty, hot, and dry summer wind from the west which blows over the western Indo-Gangetic plain region of North India and Pakistan.

qEn: Which battle was fought in 1576 between the forces of the Mughal Emperor Akbar and Maharana Pratap of Mewar?
qHi: मुगल सम्राट अकबर और मेवाड़ के महाराणा प्रताप की सेनाओं के बीच 1576 में कौन सा युद्ध लड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The Battle of Haldighati was fought on June 18, 1576, at Haldighati in Rajasthan between cavalry and archers supporting the Maharana Pratap, and the Mughal emperor Akbar's force.

qEn: Which of the following dynasties constructed the famous Kailash Temple at Ellora?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस राजवंश ने एलोora के प्रसिद्ध कैलाश मंदिर का निर्माण कराया था?
explainEn: The rock-cut Kailash Temple (Cave 16) at Ellora was built by the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I.

qEn: Where is the headquarters of the International Labour Organization (ILO) located?
qHi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय श्रम संगठन (ILO) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
explainEn: The headquarters of the International Labour Organization is located in Geneva, Switzerland.

qEn: At which session did the Indian National Congress adopt the historic 'Purna Swaraj' resolution?
qHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने किस अधिवेशन में ऐतिहासिक 'पूर्ण स्वराज' प्रस्ताव को अपनाया था?
explainEn: The Lahore session of the Indian National Congress passed the Purna Swaraj resolution in December 1929.

qEn: Which vitamin is primarily responsible for the clotting of blood?

explainEn: Vitamin K helps in the synthesis of various proteins that are required for blood coagulation or clotting.

qEn: Which layer of the atmosphere contains the ozone layer that protects us from ultraviolet rays?
qHi: वायुमंडल की किस परत में ओजोन परत पाई जाती है जो हमें पराबैंगनी किरणों से बचाती है?
explainEn: The stratosphere contains the ozone layer, which absorbs harmful ultraviolet radiation from the sun.

qEn: Which of the following is the SI unit of electric current?
qHi: विद्युत धारा की एसआई (SI) इकाई निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी है?
explainEn: The Ampere is the base unit of electric current in the International System of Units (SI).

qEn: Which amendment of the Constitution of India added the Fundamental Duties?
qHi: भारत के संविधान के किस संशोधन द्वारा मौलिक कर्तव्यों को जोड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The Fundamental Duties were added to Part IV-A of the Constitution by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976.

qEn: Who was the founder of the Maurya Empire after overthrowing the Nanda Dynasty?
qHi: नंद वंश को उखाड़ फेंकने के बाद मौर्य साम्राज्य की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire in 322 BCE with the help of Chanakya by defeating the Nanda ruler Dhanananda.

qEn: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting mechanisms in the human body?
qHi: मानव शरीर में रक्त का थक्का जमने के लिए कौन सा विटामिन आवश्यक है?
explainEn: Vitamin K plays a major role in blood clotting, bone metabolism, and regulating blood calcium levels.

qEn: During the Gupta period, what was the term 'Vishti' used to designate?
qHi: गुप्त काल के दौरान 'विष्टि' शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
explainEn: Vishti refers to forced, unpaid labor that was exacted by the state or feudal lords in ancient India, particularly documented in Gupta inscriptions.

qEn: Which among the following elements is a metalloid found in group 15 of the periodic table?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा तत्व आवर्त सारणी के समूह 15 में पाया जाने वाला एक उपधातु है?
explainEn: Antimony (Sb) is a metalloid belonging to Group 15 of the modern periodic table, whereas Nitrogen and Phosphorus are non-metals, and Bismuth is a metal.

qEn: Which river valley in India is famous for its extensive badland topography and ravines formed by severe gully erosion?
qHi: भारत की कौन सी नदी घाटी गंभीर गली अपरदन द्वारा निर्मित अपनी व्यापक बीहड़ स्थलाकृति और खड्डों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: The Chambal river basin is well-known for its extensive ravines and badland topography caused by intensive soil erosion and gully cutting.

qEn: Under the Subsidiary Alliance system introduced by Lord Wellesley, Indian rulers were required to maintain a contingent of British troops and pay for their upkeep or cede territory instead. Who was the first ruler to accept this system?
qHi: लॉर्ड वेलेजली द्वारा शुरू की गई सहायक संधि प्रणाली के तहत, भारतीय शासकों को ब्रिटिश सैनिकों की एक टुकड़ी को बनाए रखने और उनके रखरखाव के लिए भुगतान करने या इसके बदले में क्षेत्र समर्पित करने की आवश्यकता थी। इस प्रणाली को स्वीकार करने वाला पहला शासक कौन था?
explainEn: The Nizam of Hyderabad was the first Indian ruler to accept the Subsidiary Alliance in 1798, followed by the ruler of Tanjore in 1799.
sourceHint: Spectrum's A Brief History of Modern India

qEn: Which type of international monetary asset is created by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and allocated to its member countries, acting as a supplement to their official reserves?
qHi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मुद्रा कोष (IMF) द्वारा किस प्रकार की अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मौद्रिक परिसंपत्ति का सृजन किया जाता है और इसके सदस्य देशों को आवंटित किया जाता है, जो उनके आधिकारिक भंडार के पूरक के रूप में कार्य करती है?
explainEn: Special Drawing Rights (SDR) is an international reserve asset created by the IMF in 1969 to supplement its member countries' official reserves.

qEn: In the human eye, what is the primary function of the ciliary muscles connected to the eye lens?
qHi: मानव नेत्र में, नेत्र लेंस से जुड़ी सिलिहारी (पक्ष्माभी) पेशियों का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: To alter the curvature and focal length of the eye lens
To regulate the absolute amount of light entering the pupil
To protect the retina from high-intensity solar radiation
To maintain the fluid pressure inside the aqueous chamber
optsHi: नेत्र लेंस की वक्रता और फोकल लंबाई को बदलना
पुतली में प्रवेश करने वाले प्रकाश की मात्रा को विनियमित करना
रेटिना को उच्च तीव्रता वाले सौर विकिरण से बचाना
जलीय कक्ष के अंदर द्रव दबाव को बनाए रखना
explainEn: The ciliary muscles modify the shape of the crystalline lens of the eye to focus images on the retina from varying distances, a process known as accommodation.

qEn: Kolkata city is situated on the banks of which river?
qHi: कोलकाता शहर किस नदी के तट पर स्थित है?
explainEn: Kolkata, the capital of West Bengal, is located on the eastern bank of the Hooghly River.

qEn: Which vitamin is abundant in citrus fruits like oranges and lemons?
qHi: संतरे और नींबू जैसे खट्टे फलों में कौन सा विटामिन प्रचुर मात्रा में पाया जाता है?
explainEn: Citrus fruits are rich sources of ascorbic acid, commonly known as Vitamin C.

qEn: At which of the following sites was the first Session of the Indian National Congress held in 1885?
qHi: 1885 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का पहला अधिवेशन निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थान पर आयोजित किया गया था?
explainEn: The first session of the Indian National Congress was held in Bombay in December 1885 at Gokuldas Tejpal Sanskrit College.

qEn: Which among the following atmospheric layers contains the ozone layer that absorbs harmful ultraviolet rays?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस वायुमंडलीय परत में ओजोन परत पाई जाती है जो हानिकारक पराबैंगनी किरणों को अवशोषित करती है?
explainEn: The stratosphere contains the ozone layer, which absorbs most of the Sun's ultraviolet radiation.

qEn: Which Vijayanagara ruler founded the city of Nagalapuram in memory of his mother?
qHi: किस विजयनगर शासक ने अपनी माँ की स्मृति में नागालापुरम शहर की स्थापना की थी?
explainEn: Krishnadevaraya, the famous ruler of the Tuluva dynasty of the Vijayanagara Empire, founded a suburban township called Nagalapuram in honor of his mother Nagaladevi.

qEn: Which of the following rivers flows through a rift valley in India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी नदी भारत में एक भ्रंश घाटी (िफ्ट वैली) से होकर बहती है?
explainEn: The Narmada and Tapti are major peninsular rivers in India that flow through rift valleys formed due to faulting.

qEn: During the British colonial period in India, the Ilbert Bill was introduced in which year?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक काल के दौरान, इल्बर्ट बिल किस वर्ष प्रस्तुत किया गया था?
explainEn: The Ilbert Bill was introduced in 1883 during the Viceroyalty of Lord Ripon to allow Indian judges to try European offenders.

qEn: As per the Koppen climate classification, which climatic type is designated by the letters 'Am'?
qHi: कोप्पेन के जलवायु वर्गीकरण के अनुसार, 'Am' अक्षरों द्वारा किस प्रकार की जलवायु को दर्शाया जाता है?
explainEn: In Koppen's climate classification, 'Am' stands for Tropical Monsoon climate, characterized by short dry seasons and heavy monsoon rainfall.

qEn: The 'Barak Valley', an important physiographic and cultural region, is located in which state of India?
qHi: एक महत्वपूर्ण भौतिक और सांस्कृतिक क्षेत्र 'बराक घाटी' भारत के किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: The Barak Valley is located in the southern part of Assam and is named after the Barak River.

qEn: Which of the following sites of the Indus Valley Civilization is located in the state of Gujarat and is famous for its dockyard?
qHi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा स्थल गुजरात राज्य में स्थित है और अपने गोदीवाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Lothal, situated along the Bhogavo river in Gujarat, features a massive tidal dockyard, making it an important trading center of the Indus Valley Civilization.

qEn: In which biogeographic zone of India are the Andaman and Nicobar Islands typically classified?
qHi: भारत के किस जैव-भौगोलिक क्षेत्र में अंडमान और निकोबार द्वीप समूह को आमतौर पर वर्गीकृत किया जाता है?
explainEn: Wildlife Institute of India classifies India into 10 biogeographic zones, with the Andaman and Nicobar Islands forming a distinct zone of their own.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

qEn: Who among the following propounded the 'Drain of Wealth' theory during the British colonial rule?
qHi: ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन के दौरान निम्नलिखित में से किसने 'धन की निकासी' (Drain of Wealth) सिद्धांत प्रतिपादित किया था?
explainEn: Dadabhai Naoroji propounded the Drain of Wealth theory, explaining how British policies were siphoning India's wealth to Britain.

qEn: What type of forest is predominantly found in regions receiving annual rainfall between 70 cm and 200 cm in India?
qHi: भारत में 70 सेमी से 200 सेमी के बीच वार्षिक वर्षा प्राप्त करने वाले क्षेत्रों में मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकार के वन पाए जाते हैं?
explainEn: Tropical Deciduous forests, also known as monsoon forests, thrive in regions with annual rainfall between 70 cm and 200 cm.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the officer responsible for maintaining the royal treasury and archives was known by which title?
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, राजशाही खजाने और अभिलेखागार को बनाए रखने के लिए जिम्मेदार अधिकारी को किस उपाधि से जाना जाता था?
explainEn: In the administrative system of the Gupta period, the Akshapataladhikrita was the officer-in-charge of the royal records, archives, and accounts.

qEn: The 'Koderma' district in Jharkhand is predominantly famous for the large-scale extraction and deposit of which mineral?
qHi: झारखंड का 'कोडरमा' जिला मुख्य रूप से किस खनिज के बड़े पैमाने पर उत्पादन और भंडार के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Koderma is known as the 'Mica Capital of India' due to its extensive deposits of mica.

qEn: Which specific plant hormone is primarily responsible for inducing cell division in plants and was discovered as kinetin?
qHi: पौधों में कोशिका विभाजन को प्रेरित करने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा विशिष्ट पादप हार्मोन जिम्मेदार है और जिसकी खोज काइनिटिन के रूप में हुई थी?
explainEn: Cytokinins are plant hormones that promote cell division (cytokinesis) in plant roots and shoots, first discovered as kinetin from autoclaved herring sperm DNA.

qEn: Under the colonial British administration, the Vernacular Press Act was enacted in which specific year?
qHi: औपनिवेशिक ब्रिटिश प्रशासन के तहत, वर्नाक्युलर प्रेस एक्ट (देशी भाषा प्रेस अधिनियम) किस वर्ष अधिनियमित किया गया था?
explainEn: The Vernacular Press Act was passed in 1878 by Viceroy Lord Lytton to curtail the freedom of the Indian-language press.
sourceHint: Modern Indian History Textbooks, Spectrum / NCERT

qEn: The tropical cyclone that originates in the Arabian Sea or Bay of Bengal is scientifically classified under which broad category of meteorological phenomena?
qHi: अरब सागर या बंगाल की खाड़ी में उत्पन्न होने वाले उष्णकटिबंधीय चक्रवात को वैज्ञानिक रूप से मौसम संबंधी घटनाओं की किस व्यापक श्रेणी के तहत वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
explainEn: Cyclones developing in the region of the Indian Ocean, including the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal, are officially categorized as tropical cyclones.

qEn: Which Gupta ruler assumed the title of 'Vikramaditya' after defeating the Western Kshatrapas?
qHi: किस गुप्त शासक ने पश्चिमी क्षत्रपों को हराने के बाद 'विक्रमादित्य' की उपाधि धारण की थी?
explainEn: Chandragupta II adopted the title Vikramaditya following his victory over the Saka ruler of Western India (Western Kshatrapas).

qEn: In monetary economics, which aggregate of money supply in India is commonly referred to as 'broad money'?
qHi: मौद्रिक अर्थशास्त्र में, भारत में मुद्रा आपूर्ति के किस समुच्चय को आमतौर पर 'व्यापक मुद्रा' (ब्रॉड मनी) कहा जाता है?
explainEn: M3 is known as broad money in India because it includes currency with the public, demand deposits with banks, time deposits with banks, and other deposits with the RBI.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Which date is observed globally as World Students' Day in honor of Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam?
qHi: डॉ. ए. पी. जे. अब्दुल कलाम के सम्मान में किस तिथि को विश्व छात्र दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है?
explainEn: World Students' Day is celebrated annually on October 15, which marks the birth anniversary of Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Which of the following autobiographical books was written by Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी आत्मकथात्मक पुस्तक डॉ. ए. पी. जे. अब्दुल कलाम द्वारा लिखी गई थी?
explainEn: 'Wings of Fire' is the autobiography of Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, co-written by Arun Tiwari.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam is widely known by which popular title in India due to his connection with space and missiles?
qHi: अंतरिक्ष और मिसाइलों से अपने जुड़ाव के कारण डॉ. ए. पी. जे. अब्दुल कलाम को भारत में किस लोकप्रिय नाम से जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam played a pivotal role in the development of India's ballistic missile technology, earning him the title 'Missile Man of India'.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: At which premier Indian space organization did Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam work as a Project Director for India's first indigenous Satellite Launch Vehicle?
qHi: डॉ. ए. पी. जे. अब्दुल कलाम ने भारत के पहले स्वदेशी उपग्रह प्रक्षेपण वाहन के प्रोजेक्ट डायरेक्टर के रूप में किस प्रमुख भारतीय अंतरिक्ष संगठन में कार्य किया था?
explainEn: Dr. Kalam served as the Project Director for ISRO's SLV-III, which successfully injected the Rohini satellite into near-earth orbit in 1980.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Which United Nations body declared October 15 as World Students' Day?
qHi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र के किस अंग ने 15 अक्टूबर को विश्व छात्र दिवस के रूप में घोषित किया था?
explainEn: UNESCO recognized October 15 as World Students' Day in 2010, honoring Dr. Kalam's dedication to teaching and students.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Which civilian honor was conferred upon Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam in the year 1997?
qHi: वर्ष 1997 में डॉ. ए. पी. जे. अब्दुल कलाम को कौन सा नागरिक सम्मान प्रदान किया गया था?
explainEn: Dr. Kalam was awarded India's highest civilian honor, the Bharat Ratna, in 1997 for his contribution to scientific research and modernization of defense technology.
sourceHint: Ministry of Home Affairs Padma Awards directory

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam played a pivotal role as the Project Director of which major Indian space launch vehicle?
qHi: डॉ. ए. पी. जे. अब्दुल कलाम ने भारत के किस प्रमुख अंतरिक्ष प्रक्षेपण वाहन के परियोजना निदेशक के रूप में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई?
explainEn: Dr. Kalam was the Project Director of India's first indigenous Satellite Launch Vehicle (SLV-III) which successfully deployed the Rohini satellite in 1980.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Which among the following books is a well-known autobiographical work co-authored by Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी पुस्तक डॉ. ए. पी. जे. अब्दुल कलाम द्वारा सह-लेखित एक प्रसिद्ध आत्मकथात्मक कृति है?
explainEn: 'Wings of Fire: An Autobiography' was co-authored by Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam and Arun Tiwari.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: What was the codename of the 1998 Indian nuclear tests in Rajasthan, directed by Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam along with R. Chidambaram?
qHi: राजस्थान में 1998 के भारतीय परमाणु परीक्षणों का कूट नाम क्या था, जिसका निर्देशन डॉ. ए. पी. जे. अब्दुल कलाम ने आर. चिदंबरम के साथ किया था?
explainEn: Pokhran-II nuclear tests conducted in May 1998 were collectively known as Operation Shakti, where Dr. Kalam served as the Chief Scientific Adviser to the Prime Minister.
sourceHint: Department of Atomic Energy and DRDO archives

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: In which city did Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam spend his early school years before graduating in Physics from St. Joseph's College, Tiruchirappalli?
qHi: सेंट जोसेफ कॉलेज, तिरुचिरापल्ली से भौतिकी में स्नातक करने से पहले डॉ. ए. पी. जे. अब्दुल कलाम ने अपने शुरुआती स्कूली वर्ष किस शहर में बिताए?
explainEn: Dr. Kalam was born and raised in Rameswaram, where he attended Schwartz Higher Secondary School.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 9 English textbook Chapter 'My Childhood'

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam served as the Project Director for which of India's first indigenous satellite launch vehicles at ISRO?
qHi: डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम ने इसरो में भारत के पहले स्वदेशी उपग्रह प्रक्षेपण वाहनों में से किस के परियोजना निदेशक के रूप में कार्य किया था?
explainEn: Dr. Kalam was the Project Director of India's first Satellite Launch Vehicle (SLV-3), which successfully injected the Rohini satellite in 1980.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Which prestigious civilian award was conferred upon Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam in the year 1997?
qHi: वर्ष 1997 में डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम को किस प्रतिष्ठित नागरिक पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया था?
explainEn: Dr. Kalam was awarded India's highest civilian honor, the Bharat Ratna, in 1997 for his immense contribution to scientific research and modernization of defense technology.
sourceHint: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Which autobiographical book by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam details his early life in Rameswaram and his journey in Indian aerospace?
qHi: डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम की किस आत्मकथात्मक पुस्तक में रामेश्वरम में उनके शुरुआती जीवन और भारतीय एयरोस्पेस में उनकी यात्रा का विवरण है?
explainEn: Wings of Fire: An Autobiography of A.P.J. Abdul Kalam was co-authored by Arun Tiwari and published in 1999.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: During his tenure as the Principal Scientific Adviser to the Government of India, Dr. Kalam formulated a technological roadmap known by which acronym?
qHi: भारत सरकार के प्रधान वैज्ञानिक सलाहकार के रूप में अपने कार्यकाल के दौरान, डॉ. कलाम ने किस संक्षिप्त नाम से जाने जाने वाले तकनीकी रोडमैप को तैयार किया था?
explainEn: Dr. Kalam co-authored the book 'India 2020: A Vision for the New Millennium', outlining a roadmap to transform India into a developed nation.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: At which premier academic institution did Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam serve as a professor of technology and societal transformation in his final years?
qHi: अपने अंतिम वर्षों में डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम ने किस प्रमुख शैक्षणिक संस्थान में प्रौद्योगिकी और सामाजिक परिवर्तन के प्रोफेसर के रूप में कार्य किया था?
explainEn: Dr. Kalam collapsed and passed away while delivering a lecture to students at IIM Shillong on July 27, 2015.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam played a pivotal organizational and technical role in India's 1998 nuclear tests, serving in which official capacity at that time?
qHi: डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम ने 1998 के भारत के परमाणु परीक्षणों में किस आधिकारिक क्षमता में कार्य करते हुए एक महत्वपूर्ण संगठनात्मक और तकनीकी भूमिका निभाई थी?
optsEn: Scientific Advisor to the Defence Minister and Secretary, DRDO
Principal Scientific Advisor to the Prime Minister
optsHi: रक्षा मंत्री के वैज्ञानिक सलाहकार और सचिव, डीआरडीओ
प्रधान मंत्री के प्रधान वैज्ञानिक सलाहकार
explainEn: During the Pokhran-II nuclear tests in May 1998, Dr. Kalam was the Scientific Adviser to the Defence Minister and Secretary of the Department of Defence Research and Development.

special: World Students' Day / Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
qEn: Which specific missile development program in India was spearheaded by Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam as its Chief Executive during the 1980s?
qHi: 1980 के दशक के दौरान भारत में किस विशिष्ट मिसाइल विकास कार्यक्रम का नेतृत्व डॉ. ए.पी.जे. अब्दुल कलाम ने इसके मुख्य कार्यकारी के रूप में किया था?
explainEn: Dr. Kalam spearheaded the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme (IGMDP), which led to the development of missiles like Agni and Prithvi.

qEn: Who is the custodian of the Constitution of India?
qHi: भारत के संविधान का संरक्षक कौन है?
explainEn: The Supreme Court is the final interpreter and custodian of the Indian Constitution.
sourceHint: Constitution of India / NCERT Class 11 Political Science

qEn: Which organism is commonly known as the 'Portuguese man-of-war'?
qHi: किस जीव को आमतौर पर 'पुर्तगाली मैन-ऑफ-वार' कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Physalia physalis, a marine cnidarian, is commonly known as the Portuguese man-of-war.

qEn: The 'Purna Swaraj' resolution was formally adopted at which session of the Indian National Congress?
qHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के किस अधिवेशन में 'पूर्ण स्वराज' प्रस्ताव को औपचारिक रूप से अपनाया गया था?
explainEn: The Lahore session of the INC in December 1929 passed the Purna Swaraj resolution under the presidency of Jawaharlal Nehru.
sourceHint: Modern Indian History by Bipin Chandra

qEn: What is the primary function of ribosomes inside a living cell?
qHi: एक जीवित कोशिका के अंदर राइबोसोम का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
explainEn: Ribosomes are cellular structures responsible for synthesizing proteins by translating messenger RNA.

qEn: Which Mughal ruler shifted the capital from Agra to Delhi by founding Shahjahanabad?
qHi: किस मुगल शासक ने शाहजहांबाद की स्थापना करके राजधानी को आगरा से दिल्ली स्थानांतरित किया था?
explainEn: Shah Jahan shifted his capital from Agra to Delhi in 1648, where he built the walled city of Shahjahanabad.

qEn: Which battle established Mughal rule in India in 1526?
qHi: 1526 में किस युद्ध ने भारत में मुगल शासन की स्थापना की?
explainEn: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in the First Battle of Panipat in 1526, marking the beginning of the Mughal Empire.

qEn: Which Indian state is the largest producer of bauxite, according to standard mineral data?
qHi: मानक खनिज डेटा के अनुसार, कौन सा भारतीय राज्य बॉक्साइट का सबसे बड़ा उत्पादक है?
explainEn: Odisha is the leading producer of bauxite in India, accounting for a major share of the total production.
sourceHint: Ministry of Mines, Government of India / NCERT

qEn: What is the minimum age required to be eligible for election to the office of President of India?
qHi: भारत के राष्ट्रपति पद के चुनाव के लिए पात्र होने के लिए न्यूनतम आयु कितनी आवश्यक है?
explainEn: According to Article 58 of the Constitution, a candidate must have completed the age of 35 years to become the President of India.

qEn: Kaziranga National Park is famous for which of the following animals?
qHi: काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान निम्नलिखित में से किस जानवर के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Located in Assam, Kaziranga National Park hosts two-thirds of the world's great Indian one-horned rhinoceroses.

qEn: Which of the following atmospheric layers is responsible for the reflection of radio waves back to the Earth?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वायुमंडलीय परत रेडियो तरंगों को वापस पृथ्वी पर परावर्तित करने के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: The thermosphere contains the ionosphere, which has electrically charged particles that reflect radio waves.

qEn: Which writ is issued by a higher court to a lower court or tribunal to prevent it from exceeding its jurisdiction?
qHi: अपनी अधिकार क्षेत्र से बाहर जाने से रोकने के लिए किसी उच्च न्यायालय द्वारा निचली अदालत या न्यायाधिकरण को कौन सी रिट जारी की जाती है?
explainEn: The writ of Prohibition is issued by a higher court to a lower court to prevent them from exceeding their jurisdiction.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth / Constitution Article 32

qEn: What is the primary commercial product obtained from the tree species 'Cinchona'?
qHi: सिंचोना वृक्ष प्रजाति से प्राप्त होने वाला मुख्य व्यावसायिक उत्पाद क्या है?
explainEn: Quinine, an antimalarial drug, is extracted from the bark of the Cinchona tree.

qEn: Under which article of the Indian Constitution is the President empowered to grant pardons?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत राष्ट्रपति को क्षमादान देने की शक्ति प्राप्त है?
explainEn: Article 72 of the Constitution of India gives the President the power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissions of punishment.

qEn: Kaziranga National Park is famous for which animal?
qHi: काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस जानवर के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Located in Assam, Kaziranga National Park hosts two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional dance festival associated with which state?
qHi: बिहू किस राज्य से जुड़ा एक पारंपरिक नृत्य उत्सव है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural festivals of Assam namely Rongali Bihu, Kongali Bihu, and Bhogali Bihu.

qEn: In which biogeographic zone of India is the Kaziranga National Park primarily situated?
qHi: काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान मुख्य रूप से भारत के किस जैव-भौगोलिक क्षेत्र में स्थित है?
explainEn: Kaziranga National Park is located in the Brahmaputra Valley floodplains, which falls under the North-East biogeographic zone of India.
sourceHint: NCERT Geography / Wildlife Institute of India

qEn: Which of the following dynasties constructed the famous Kailasa temple at Ellora?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस राजवंश ने एलोरा में प्रसिद्ध कैलाश मंदिर का निर्माण करवाया था?
explainEn: The monolithic Kailasa temple (Cave 16) at Ellora was built by the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I in the 8th century.

qEn: What is the primary commercial product extracted from the 'Cinchona' plant?
qHi: 'सिनकोना' पौधे से निकाला जाने वाला मुख्य व्यावसायिक उत्पाद क्या है?
explainEn: Quinine is an alkaloid derived from the bark of the Cinchona tree, historically used in the treatment of malaria.

qEn: Which wind system is primarily responsible for bringing winter rainfall to the northwestern part of India?
qHi: भारत के उत्तर-पश्चिमी भाग में शीतकालीन वर्षा लाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी पवन प्रणाली जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Western Disturbances are extratropical storms originating in the Mediterranean region that bring sudden winter rain and snow to northwestern India.

qEn: Bhangra is a traditional folk dance associated with which Indian state?
qHi: भांगड़ा किस भारतीय राज्य से जुड़ा एक पारंपरिक लोक नृत्य है?
explainEn: Bhangra is a lively folk dance originating from the Punjab region.

qEn: Which of the following is the standard unit of electric current in the SI system?
qHi: एसआई प्रणाली में विद्युत धारा की मानक इकाई निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी है?
explainEn: The ampere is the base unit of electric current in the International System of Units (SI).

qEn: Which river originates from Mahabaleshwar in Maharashtra?
qHi: महाराष्ट्र में महाबलेश्वर से कौन सी नदी निकलती है?
explainEn: The Krishna River rises in the Western Ghats at an elevation of about 1,337 meters just north of Mahabaleshwar.

qEn: Which Indian state shares its longest land boundary with Myanmar?
qHi: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य म्यांमार के साथ सबसे लंबी थल सीमा साझा करता है?
explainEn: Arunachal Pradesh shares the longest international border with Myanmar among the northeastern states of India.
sourceHint: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

qEn: During the British colonial period in India, the Doctrine of Lapse was predominantly used to annex princely states by which Governor-General?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन के दौरान, किस गवर्नर-जनरल द्वारा 'व्यपगत का सिद्धांत' (Doctrine of Lapse) का उपयोग करके मुख्य रूप से रियासतें हड़पी गईं?
explainEn: Lord Dalhousie, who served as Governor-General from 1848 to 1856, extensively applied the Doctrine of Lapse to annex states like Satara, Nagpur, and Jhansi.

qEn: Which river basin in India is characterized by extensive ravine erosion, locally known as 'badland topography' or ravines?
qHi: भारत की किस नदी द्रोणी की विशेषता व्यापक खड्ड अपरदन है, जिसे स्थानीय रूप से 'बेडलैंड स्थलाकृति' या बीहड़ कहा जाता है?
explainEn: The Chambal River basin is well known for its extensive network of ravines formed by severe gully erosion in central India.

qEn: At which Indus Valley Civilization site was a dockyard discovered by archaeologists?
qHi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के किस स्थल पर पुरातत्वविदों द्वारा एक गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) खोजा गया था?
explainEn: Lothal, situated in Gujarat, features a massive brick basin identified by archaeologists as a tidal dockyard.

qEn: Who founded the socio-religious reform movement known as the Brahmo Samaj in 1828?
qHi: 1828 में ब्रह्म समाज नामक सामाजिक-धार्मिक सुधार आंदोलन की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded the Brahmo Samaj in Calcutta in 1828 to reform Hindu society and eradicate idolatry and social evils.

qEn: Which vitamin is chemically known as Ascorbic Acid and acts as an antioxidant in the human body?
qHi: किस विटामिन को रासायनिक रूप से एस्कॉर्बिक एसिड कहा जाता है और यह मानव शरीर में एक एंटीऑक्सीडेंट के रूप में कार्य करता है?
explainEn: Vitamin C is water-soluble and is chemically designated as L-ascorbic acid, essential for tissue repair and enzymatic production.

qEn: Which of the following dynasties constructed the Ellora Caves?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस राजवंश ने एलोरा गुफाओं का निर्माण करवाया था?
explainEn: The Ellora Caves were built during the rule of the Rashtrakuta dynasty, with cave 16 being the famous Kailash temple.

qEn: Which vitamin deficiency causes the disease known as beri-beri?
qHi: किस विटामिन की कमी के कारण बेरी-बेरी नामक रोग होता है?
explainEn: Beri-beri is a disease caused by a deficiency of Vitamin B1, also known as thiamine.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which institution is legally mandated to fix the benchmark interest rate under the Flexible Inflation Targeting framework?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, किस संस्था को लचीली मुद्रास्फीति लक्ष्यीकरण (Flexible Inflation Targeting) फ्रेमवर्क के तहत बेंचमार्क ब्याज दर तय करने का कानूनी अधिकार प्राप्त है?
explainEn: Under Section 45ZB of the RBI Act, 1934, the Central Government is empowered to constitute a six-member Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) to determine the policy interest rate required to achieve the inflation target.
sourceHint: RBI Act, 1934 / Indian Economy by Ramesh Singh

qEn: Which of the following archaeological sites is famous for yielding the largest Harappan reservoir and a sophisticated water management system?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा पुरातात्विक स्थल सबसे बड़े हड़प्पा कालीन जलाशय और एक परिष्कृत जल प्रबंधन प्रणाली के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Dholavira, located in Gujarat, is renowned for its unique water management system, featuring a series of massive stone-cut water reservoirs and stepwells.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Themes in Indian History Part I

qEn: The 'Kaziranga Tiger Reserve' is primarily bounded to the north by which major river?
qHi: 'काजीरंगा टाइगर रिजर्व' मुख्य रूप से उत्तर में किस प्रमुख नदी से घिरा हुआ है?
explainEn: Kaziranga National Park and Tiger Reserve is situated in the floodplains of the Brahmaputra River, which forms its northern boundary.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change / Wildlife Institute of India

qEn: The 'Helioseismic and Magnetic Imager' (HMI) and 'Atmospheric Imaging Assembly' (AIA) are key scientific instruments onboard which solar observation space mission?
qHi: 'हिलियोसिस्मिक एंड मैग्नेटिक इमेजर' (HMI) और 'एटमॉस्फेरिक इमेजिंग असेंबली' (AIA) किस सौर अवलोकन अंतरिक्ष मिशन पर लगे प्रमुख वैज्ञानिक उपकरण हैं?
explainEn: Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO), launched by NASA, carries instruments including HMI and AIA to study the solar atmosphere and magnetic field.

qEn: Which vitamin is abundantly available in citrus fruits like oranges and lemons?
qHi: संतरे और नींबू जैसे खट्टे फलों में कौन सा विटामिन प्रचुर मात्रा में पाया जाता है?
explainEn: Citrus fruits are well-known rich sources of ascorbic acid, commonly known as Vitamin C.

qEn: What is the primary gas found in the Earth's atmosphere?
qHi: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में पाई जाने वाली मुख्य गैस कौन सी है?
explainEn: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere by volume.

qEn: Which national highway is known as the historical Grand Trunk Road in India?
qHi: भारत में किस राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग को ऐतिहासिक ग्रांड ट्रंक रोड के रूप में जाना जाता है?
explainEn: The historic Grand Trunk Road spans the routes covered by National Highway 1 (Delhi to Amritsar) and National Highway 2 (Delhi to Kolkata).

qEn: Which of the following writs is issued by a higher court to a lower court to prevent excess of jurisdiction?
qHi: अधिकार क्षेत्र से अधिक कार्य करने को रोकने के लिए उच्च न्यायालय द्वारा निचली अदालत को निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी रिट जारी की जाती है?
explainEn: The writ of Prohibition is issued by a higher court to a lower court or tribunal to prevent them from exceeding their jurisdiction.

qEn: Nokrek Biosphere Reserve is located in which Indian state?
qHi: नोकरेक बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व किस भारतीय राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Nokrek Biosphere Reserve is located in the Garo Hills district of Meghalaya and is also a UNESCO World Heritage site.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India

qEn: The 'Barak Valley', known for tea cultivation and swamp forests, is situated in which state of India?
qHi: चाय की खेती और दलदली जंगलों के लिए प्रसिद्ध 'बराॅक घाटी' भारत के किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Barak Valley is located in the southern part of Assam, named after the Barak River, and is a major hub for tea production.
sourceHint: Geography of India by Majid Husain / NCERT

qEn: The famous 'Aihole Inscription', written in Sanskrit and composed in the Kannada script style, praises the achievements of which Chalukya ruler?
qHi: संस्कृत में रचित और कन्नड़ लिपि शैली में लिखित प्रसिद्ध 'ऐहोल शिलालेख' किस चालुक्य शासक की उपलब्धियों की प्रशंसा करता है?
explainEn: The Aihole Inscription at Meguti Jain temple was composed by the court poet Ravikirti and details the military exploits and victory of Pulakeshin II over Harshavardhana.
sourceHint: Ancient India by R.S. Sharma / NIOS History

qEn: As per the Köppen climate classification, which symbol denotes the tropical monsoon climate found in the coastal regions of southwestern India?
qHi: कोपेन के जलवायु वर्गीकरण के अनुसार, दक्षिण-पश्चिमी भारत के तटीय क्षेत्रों में पाई जाने वाली उष्णकटिबंधीय मानसून जलवायु को कौन सा प्रतीक दर्शाता है?
explainEn: In Köppen's classification, 'Am' stands for Tropical Monsoon Climate with short dry season, typical of the western coast of India.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - India: Physical Environment

qEn: Under the provisions of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, the minimum reserve system for note issue requires the maintenance of gold and foreign currency reserves of what value?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक अधिनियम, 1934 के प्रावधानों के तहत, नोट जारी करने के लिए न्यूनतम आरक्षित प्रणाली के तहत सोने और विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार का कितना मूल्य बनाए रखना आवश्यक है?
explainEn: The RBI operates under the Minimum Reserve System, where it must maintain a total of Rs 200 crore in gold and foreign securities, out of which at least Rs 115 crore must be in gold.
sourceHint: Indian Economy by Ramesh Singh / RBI Publication

qEn: The 'Hague Convention' of 1954 is primarily associated with the protection of which of the following?
qHi: 1954 का 'हेग सम्मेलन' मुख्य रूप से निम्नलिखित में से किसकी सुरक्षा से संबंधित है?
optsEn: Cultural property in the event of armed conflict
Endangered marine species and coral reefs
Civil aviation against hijacking and sabotage
optsHi: सशस्त्र संघर्ष की स्थिति में सांस्कृतिक संपत्ति
लुप्तप्राय समुद्री प्रजातियां और प्रवाल भित्तियां
साइबर सुरक्षा और सीमा पार डेटा संरक्षण
अपहरण और तोड़फोड़ के खिलाफ नागरिक उड्डयन
explainEn: The 1954 Hague Convention for the Protection of Cultural Property in the Event of Armed Conflict is the first international treaty of worldwide scope focused exclusively on the protection of cultural heritage during war.

qEn: Hirakud Dam, one of the longest major earthen dams, is built across which river?
qHi: हीराकुंड बांध, जो सबसे लंबे प्रमुख मिट्टी के बांधों में से एक है, किस नदी पर बनाया गया है?
explainEn: Hirakud Dam is constructed across the Mahanadi River in Odisha.

qEn: Which historical monument is famously known as the Tegh Bahadur Memorial?
qHi: किस ऐतिहासिक स्मारक को तेग बहादुर स्मारक के रूप में भी जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Gurdwara Sis Ganj Sahib in Delhi marks the site where Guru Tegh Bahadur was martyred.

qEn: Who among the following propounded the 'Drain of Wealth' theory during the British colonial rule in India?
qHi: ब्रिटिश colonial शासन के दौरान भारत में 'धन की निकासी' (Drain of Wealth) सिद्धांत का प्रतिपादन निम्नलिखित में से किसने किया था?
explainEn: Dadabhai Naoroji propounded the 'Drain of Wealth' theory in his book 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India', explaining how Britain was draining India's wealth.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: Which of the following atmospheric layers is responsible for reflecting radio waves back to the Earth?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वायुमंडलीय परत रेडियो तरंगों को वापस पृथ्वी पर परावर्तित करने के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: The thermosphere contains the ionosphere layer, which is abundant in electrically charged ions that reflect radio waves back to Earth.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional dance and festival primarily celebrated in which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू एक पारंपरिक नृत्य और उत्सव है जो मुख्य रूप से किस भारतीय राज्य में मनाया जाता है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural festivals of Assam and also refers to the traditional dance associated with it.

qEn: What is the primary constituent gas of the Earth's atmosphere by volume?
qHi: आयतन के हिसाब से पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल की मुख्य घटक गैस कौन सी है?
explainEn: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of the Earth's atmosphere by volume, making it the most abundant gas.

qEn: Which instrument is used to measure the purity of milk?
qHi: दूध की शुद्धता मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: A lactometer is a small glass instrument used to test the purity of milk by measuring its specific gravity.

qEn: Which historical monument was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in Agra as a mausoleum for his wife?
qHi: सम्राट शाहजहाँ द्वारा आगरा में अपनी पत्नी के मकबरे के रूप में कौन सा ऐतिहासिक स्मारक बनवाया गया था?
explainEn: The Taj Mahal was commissioned by Shah Jahan in 1631 to house the tomb of his favorite wife, Mumtaz Mahal.

qEn: What is the primary constituent of natural gas?
qHi: प्राकृतिक गैस का मुख्य घटक क्या है?
explainEn: Natural gas is a naturally occurring hydrocarbon gas mixture consisting primarily of methane, along with small amounts of higher alkanes.

qEn: The Bardoli Satyagraha of 1928 was led by whom?
qHi: 1928 के बारडोली सत्याग्रह का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
explainEn: The Bardoli Satyagraha was a major movement in the independence movement led by Vallabhbhai Patel in Gujarat against enhanced land revenue.

qEn: The instrument used to measure the intensity of earthquakes is known as what?
qHi: भूकंप की तीव्रता मापने के लिए प्रयुक्त उपकरण को क्या कहा जाता है?
explainEn: A seismograph is an instrument used to detect and record earthquakes, measuring the intensity of seismic waves.

qEn: Which Battle established Mughal rule in India?
qHi: किस युद्ध ने भारत में मुगल शासन की स्थापना की?
explainEn: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in the First Battle of Panipat in 1526, establishing the Mughal Empire.

qEn: Bhartnatyam is a classical dance form originating from which state?
qHi: भरतनाट्यम किस राज्य की शास्त्रीय नृत्य शैली है?
explainEn: Bharatanatyam is a traditional classical dance form that originated in Tamil Nadu.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: Sanchi Stupa, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, was commissioned by which Mauryan emperor?
qHi: यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल सांची स्तूप का निर्माण किस मौर्य सम्राट ने करवाया था?
explainEn: The Great Stupa at Sanchi was originally commissioned by the Mauryan emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BCE.

qEn: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting?
qHi: रक्त का थक्का जमने के लिए कौन सा विटामिन आवश्यक है?
explainEn: Vitamin K plays a major role in blood clotting, bone metabolism, and regulating blood calcium levels.

qEn: The river Brahmaputra enters India through which state?
qHi: ब्रह्मपुत्र नदी किस राज्य से होकर भारत में प्रवेश करती है?
explainEn: The Brahmaputra enters India in Arunachal Pradesh, where it is called the Siang and then the Dihang.

qEn: During the British colonial period in India, the 'Mahalwari System' of land revenue settlement was primarily introduced in which of the following regions?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश ঔपनिबेसिक काल के दौरान भू-राजस्व बंदोबस्त की 'महाल्वाड़ी व्यवस्था' मुख्य रूप से निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्र में शुरू की गई थी?
optsEn: North-Western Provinces, Central Provinces, and Punjab
Madras Presidency and parts of Karnataka
optsHi: उत्तर-पश्चिमी प्रांत, मध्य प्रांत और पंजाब
मद्रास प्रेसीडेंसी और कर्नाटक के कुछ हिस्से
explainEn: The Mahalwari system was devised by Holt Mackenzie and implemented extensively in the North-Western Provinces, parts of Central India, and Punjab.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: In the context of Indian physical geography, the Shiwalik range is geologically classified as a part of which of the following?
qHi: भारतीय भौतिक भूगोल के संदर्भ में, शिवालिक श्रेणी को भूगर्भीय रूप से निम्नलिखित में से किसका हिस्सा माना जाता है?
explainEn: The Himalayas consist of longitudinal valleys dividing them into the Greater Himalayas (Himadri), Lesser Himalayas (Himachal), and Outer Himalayas (Shiwalik).
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - India: Physical Environment

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers the President to promulgate Ordinances during the recess of Parliament?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को संसद के अवकाश के दौरान अध्यादेश प्रख्यापित करने का अधिकार देता है?
explainEn: Article 123 of the Constitution grants ordinance-making power to the President, while Article 213 grants the same power to the Governor of a State.

qEn: The atmospheric layer in which most weather phenomena such as rain, fog, and hailstorm occur is known as:
qHi: वायुमंडल की वह परत जिसमें वर्षा, कोहरा और ओलावृष्टि जैसी अधिकांश मौसमी घटनाएँ घटित होती हैं, कहलाती है:
explainEn: The troposphere is the lowest layer of Earth's atmosphere and contains approximately 75 percent of the atmosphere's mass, hosting all weather processes.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: Who among the following was the founder of the 'Satyashodhak Samaj' founded in 1873?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 1873 में स्थापित 'सत्यशोधक समाज' के संस्थापक थे?
explainEn: Jyotirao Phule founded Satyashodhak Samaj (Society of Seekers of Truth) on September 24, 1873, with the aim of liberating Shudras and other untouchable castes.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 8 History - Our Pasts III

qEn: In monetary economics, 'Repo Rate' refers to the rate at which:
qHi: मौद्रिक अर्थशास्त्र में, 'रेपो रेट' उस दर को संदर्भित करता है जिस पर:
optsEn: Commercial banks borrow short-term funds from the central bank
Central bank borrows from commercial banks
Commercial banks lend long-term funds to the public
Commercial banks lend to each other in the overnight market
optsHi: वाणिज्यिक बैंक केंद्रीय बैंक से अल्पकालिक ऋण लेते हैं
केंद्रीय बैंक वाणिज्यिक बैंकों से उधार लेता है
वाणिज्यिक बैंक जनता को दीर्घकालिक ऋण देते हैं
वाणिज्यिक बैंक ओवरनाइट मार्केट में एक-दूसरे को ऋण देते हैं
explainEn: Repo rate (Repurchase rate) is the rate at which the Reserve Bank of India lends money to commercial banks against government securities.
sourceHint: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Publications / NCERT Macroeconomics

qEn: Bihu is a traditional folk dance of which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू किस भारतीय राज्य का पारंपरिक लोक नृत्य है?
explainEn: Bihu is a popular folk dance associated with the festivals of Assam.

qEn: Which of the following constitutional amendments added the Ninth Schedule to the Constitution of India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस संविधान संशोधन द्वारा भारतीय संविधान में नौवीं अनुसूची जोड़ी गई थी?
explainEn: The First Amendment to the Constitution of India in 1951 added the Ninth Schedule to protect land reform laws from judicial review.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth / Constitution of India

qEn: The famous rock-cut Kailash Temple at Ellora was constructed under the patronage of which dynasty?
qHi: एलोरा का प्रसिद्ध चट्टान-कटी कैलाश मंदिर किस राजवंश के संरक्षण में बनवाया गया था?
explainEn: The monolithic Kailash Temple (Cave 16) at Ellora was built by the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I in the 8th century.

qEn: What is the primary ore from which aluminum is commercially extracted?
qHi: वह प्राथमिक अयस्क कौन सा है जिससे एल्युमीनियम का व्यावसायिक रूप से निष्कर्षण किया जाता है?
explainEn: Bauxite is a hydrated aluminum oxide and serves as the principal ore of aluminum.

qEn: The 'Battle of Wandiwash' fought in 1760 was a decisive conflict between which two European powers?
qHi: 1760 में लड़ी गई 'वांडीवाश की लड़ाई' किन दो यूरोपीय शक्तियों के बीच एक निर्णायक संघर्ष था?
explainEn: The Battle of Wandiwash was won by the British forces against the French during the Third Carnatic War.
sourceHint: A Brief History of Modern India by Spectrum

qEn: Who among the following was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty according to Puranic records and inscriptions?
qHi: पुराणों और अभिलेखों के अनुसार निम्नलिखित में से कौन सातवाहन वंश का संस्थापक था?
explainEn: Simukha is credited in historical sources and Puranas as the founder of the Satavahana dynasty.

qEn: In which state is the Silent Valley National Park located?
qHi: शांत घाटी राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Silent Valley National Park is situated in the Nilgiri Hills, Palakkad district of Kerala, India.

qEn: Who was the founder of the Nanda Dynasty in ancient India?
qHi: प्राचीन भारत में नंद वंश के संस्थापक कौन थे?
explainEn: Mahapadma Nanda founded the Nanda Dynasty by overthrowing the Shishunaga dynasty.

qEn: Sonal Mansingh is a classical dancer renowned for which two dance forms?
qHi: सोनाल मानसिंह एक शास्त्रीय नृत्यांगना हैं जो मुख्य रूप से किन दो नृत्य शैलियों के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं?
explainEn: Sonal Mansingh is an eminent Indian classical dancer proficient in both Bharatanatyam and Odissi.

qEn: During the British colonial period in India, the Ryotwari System of land revenue was primarily introduced in which of the following regions?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक काल के दौरान, भू-राजस्व की रैयतवाड़ी व्यवस्था मुख्य रूप से निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्र में शुरू की गई थी?
optsEn: United Provinces of Agra and Oudh
optsHi: आगरा और अवध के संयुक्त प्रांत
explainEn: The Ryotwari system was introduced by Thomas Munro and Captain Alexander Read, and it was primarily implemented in the Madras and Bombay Presidencies.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which institution is legally mandated to determine the policy rate required to achieve the inflation target?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, मुद्रास्फीति के लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए आवश्यक नीतिगत दर निर्धारित करने के लिए किस संस्था को कानूनी रूप से अधिकृत किया गया है?
optsEn: Securities and Exchange Board of India
explainEn: Under Section 45ZB of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, the Central Government is empowered to constitute a six-member Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) to determine the policy interest rate.

qEn: Which of the following tropical deciduous tree species is most predominantly found in the moist regions of the Eastern Ghats and Central India, known for yielding high-quality timber?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी उष्णकटिबंधीय पर्णपाती वृक्ष प्रजाति पूर्वी घाट और मध्य भारत के नम क्षेत्रों में सबसे प्रमुख रूप से पाई जाती है, जो उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली लकड़ी प्रदान करने के लिए जानी जाती है?
explainEn: Teak (Tectona grandis) is one of the most important tropical deciduous timber trees found in India, thriving in regions with moderate to high rainfall such as parts of Central India and the Western and Eastern Ghats.

qEn: The classical dance form Bharatanatyam originated in which Indian state?
qHi: शास्त्रीय नृत्य शैली भरतनाट्यम की उत्पत्ति किस भारतीय राज्य में हुई थी?
explainEn: Bharatanatyam is a major form of Indian classical dance that originated in Tamil Nadu.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: Bihu is a traditional festival celebrated primarily in which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू मुख्य रूप से किस भारतीय राज्य में मनाया जाने वाला पारंपरिक त्यौहार है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural festivals of Assam celebrated by the Assamese diaspora.

qEn: Which nutrient deficiency causes Beriberi in humans?
qHi: किस पोषक तत्व की कमी से मनुष्य में बेरीबेरी रोग होता है?
explainEn: Beriberi is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin B1, also known as thiamine.

qEn: In which state is the Bandipur National Park located?
qHi: बांदीपुर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Bandipur National Park is a tiger reserve established in 1974 as a wildlife reserve under Project Tiger, located in Karnataka.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides the procedure for the impeachment of the President of India?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद भारत के राष्ट्रपति पर महाभियोग की प्रक्रिया प्रदान करता है?
explainEn: Article 61 of the Constitution of India details the procedure for impeachment of the President for violation of the Constitution.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the officer in charge of the royal treasury was known by which of the following terms?
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, शाही खजाने के प्रभारी अधिकारी को निम्नलिखित में से किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
explainEn: Bhandagarika was the designation for the official in charge of the royal treasury during the Gupta period.

qEn: Which biogeographic region in India contains the Loktak Lake, famous for its floating phumdis?
qHi: भारत के किस जैव-भौगोलिक क्षेत्र में लोकटक झील स्थित है, जो अपने तैरते हुए फूमदियों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Loktak Lake is located in Manipur, which falls under the North-East biogeographic zone of India.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, what does the term 'Sterilisation' refer to?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, 'स्टरलाइजेशन' (बंध्याकरण) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
optsEn: RBI action to neutralize the impact of foreign exchange flows on domestic money supply
Commercial banks writing off non-performing assets
Government measures to eliminate fiscal deficit completely
Setting the statutory liquidity ratio to zero during inflation
optsHi: घरेलू मुद्रा आपूर्ति पर विदेशी मुद्रा प्रवाह के प्रभाव को बेअसर करने के लिए आरबीआई की कार्रवाई
वाणिज्यिक बैंकों द्वारा गैर-निष्पादित परिसंपत्तियों को बट्टे खाते में डालना
राजकोषीय घाटे को पूरी तरह से समाप्त करने के लिए सरकारी उपाय
मुद्रास्फीति के दौरान वैधानिक तरलता अनुपात को शून्य पर निर्धारित करना
explainEn: Sterilisation is a monetary policy operation where a central bank seeks to neutralize the domestic money supply impact of foreign exchange interventions, typically through open market operations.
sourceHint: RBI Publications and Indian Economy Textbooks

qEn: Which of the following rock systems in India is the primary source of more than ninety percent of the country's coal reserves?
qHi: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी चट्टान प्रणाली देश के नब्बे प्रतिशत से अधिक कोयला भंडार का प्राथमिक स्रोत है?
explainEn: Gondwana rock system holds about 98 percent of India's coal reserves and is located mainly in the valleys of Damodar, Mahanadi, and Godavari.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - India: Physical Environment

qEn: Which Gupta ruler assumed the title of 'Vikramaditya' after defeating the Shakas of Western India?
qHi: किस गुप्त शासक ने पश्चिमी भारत के शकों को पराजित करने के बाद 'विक्रमादित्य' की उपाधि धारण की थी?
explainEn: Chandragupta II defeated the Western Kshatrapas (Shakas) and adopted the title of Vikramaditya.

qEn: What is the primary function of the 'Amoebocytes' found in the phylum Porifera?
qHi: पोरीफेरा संघ में पाए जाने वाले 'अमीबोसाइट्स' का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: Transporting nutrients and playing a role in regeneration
Capturing prey directly from the water current
optsHi: श्वसन के लिए जल धाराओं का निर्माण करना
पोषण का परिवहन करना और पुनर्जनन में भूमिका निभाना
बाहरी कंकाल का समर्थन प्रदान करना
जल धारा से सीधे शिकार को पकड़ना
explainEn: Amoebocytes in sponges (Porifera) are mobile cells that transport nutrients from cells digesting food to other cells and assist in waste removal and regeneration.

qEn: Under the Regulating Act of 1773, the Governor-General of Bengal was given a council consisting of how many members?
qHi: 1773 के रेगुलेटिंग एक्ट के तहत, बंगाल के गवर्नर-जनरल को कितने सदस्यों वाली एक परिषद दी गई थी?
explainEn: The Regulating Act of 1773 established a four-member executive council to assist the Governor-General of Bengal.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth / Historical Background

qEn: Which river is known as the longest river in peninsular India?
qHi: प्रायद्वीपीय भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है?
explainEn: The Godavari is the largest river system in peninsular India and is often referred to as the Dakshina Ganga.

qEn: What is the standard chemical formula for common salt?
qHi: साधारण नमक का मानक रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Common salt is primarily sodium chloride, represented by the chemical formula NaCl.

qEn: What is the minimum age requirement to become a member of the Lok Sabha in India?
qHi: भारत में लोकसभा का सदस्य बनने के लिए न्यूनतम आयु की आवश्यकता क्या है?
explainEn: According to Article 84 of the Constitution of India, the minimum age for contesting an election to the Lok Sabha is 25 years.

qEn: In which historical site were the famous rock-cut Rathas (chariots) belonging to the Pallava dynasty constructed?
qHi: पल्लव वंश से संबंधित प्रसिद्ध शैल-कृत रथों का निर्माण किस ऐतिहासिक स्थल पर किया गया था?
explainEn: The Pancha Rathas, or monolithic rock-cut temples, were built at Mahabalipuram (Mamallapuram) during the reign of Pallava king Mahendravarman I and Narasimhavarman I.

qEn: The Battle of Buxar, which firmly established the British East India Company's political control over Bengal, was fought in which year?
qHi: बक्सर का युद्ध, जिसने बंगाल पर ब्रिटिश ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के राजनीतिक नियंत्रण को दृढ़ता से स्थापित किया, किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The Battle of Buxar was fought on October 22, 1764, between British forces and the combined army of Mir Kasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, and Shah Alam II.

qEn: Which element has the chemical symbol 'Au'?
qHi: किस तत्व का रासायनिक प्रतीक 'Au' है?
explainEn: The chemical symbol 'Au' is derived from the Latin word 'aurum', meaning 'shining dawn', which represents Gold.

qEn: The famous dance form 'Kathakali' originated and traditionally belongs to which Indian state?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध नृत्य शैली 'कथकली' की उत्पत्ति हुई है और पारंपरिक रूप से यह किस भारतीय राज्य से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance that is a story play genre of art, originating from the southern state of Kerala.
sourceHint: Centre for Cultural Resources and Training (CCRT)

qEn: In which year was the Battle of Buxar fought?
qHi: बक्सर का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The Battle of Buxar was fought on 22 October 1764 between the forces of the British East India Company and the combined army of Mir Kasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, and Shah Alam II.

qEn: Which vitamin is essential for blood clotting in human beings?
qHi: मानव शरीर में रक्त का थक्का जमने के लिए कौन सा विटामिन आवश्यक है?
explainEn: Vitamin K plays a major role in blood clotting, bone metabolism, and regulating blood calcium levels.

qEn: The Ajanta Caves are primarily known for art and architecture belonging to which religion?
qHi: अजंता की गुफाएं मुख्य रूप से किस धर्म से संबंधित कला और वास्तुकला के लिए जानी जाती हैं?
explainEn: The Ajanta Caves in Maharashtra comprise rock-cut Buddhist monument caves dating from the 2nd century BCE to about 480 CE.

qEn: Which fundamental right guarantees the protection of life and personal liberty in the Indian Constitution?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान में कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार जीवन और व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता की सुरक्षा की गारंटी देता है?
explainEn: Article 21 states that no person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

qEn: Which wind system is primarily responsible for bringing rainfall to the southern coast of India during winter?
qHi: सर्दियों के दौरान भारत के दक्षिणी तट पर वर्षा लाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी पवन प्रणाली जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: The North-East monsoon picks up moisture from the Bay of Bengal and brings winter rainfall to Tamil Nadu and parts of Andhra Pradesh.

qEn: Which of the following vitamins is also known as Ascorbic Acid?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस विटामिन को एस्कॉर्बिक एसिड के नाम से भी जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Vitamin C is chemically known as Ascorbic Acid. Its deficiency causes scurvy.

qEn: Which of the following gas constituents is present in the highest percentage in Earth's atmosphere?
qHi: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी गैस सबसे अधिक प्रतिशत में मौजूद है?
explainEn: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere.

qEn: Who among the following appoints the Chief Justice of India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश की नियुक्ति करता है?
explainEn: Under Article 124 of the Constitution, the President of India appoints the Chief Justice.

qEn: Kaziranga National Park, famous for the one-horned rhinoceros, is located in which Indian state?
qHi: एक सींग वाले गैंडे के लिए प्रसिद्ध काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस भारतीय राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Kaziranga National Park is situated in the state of Assam.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional dance and festival primarily associated with which state?
qHi: बिहू एक पारंपरिक नृत्य और उत्सव है जो मुख्य रूप से किस राज्य से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural festivals of Assam celebrated by the Assamese diaspora.

qEn: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) nationalised?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) का राष्ट्रीयकरण किस वर्ष किया गया था?
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India, established in 1935 under the RBI Act 1934, was nationalised on January 1, 1949.

qEn: Which Gupta ruler is known as the 'Napoleon of India' due to his military conquests?
qHi: किस गुप्त शासक को उसकी सैन्य विजयों के कारण 'भारत का नेपोलियन' कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Historian V.A. Smith referred to Samudragupta as the Napoleon of India because of his extensive military campaigns as recorded on the Allahabad Pillar inscription.

qEn: What is the primary function of the judiciary in a federal system like India?
qHi: भारत जैसी संघीय प्रणाली में न्यायपालिका का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: Resolving disputes and interpreting the Constitution
optsHi: विवादों का समाधान करना और संविधान की व्याख्या करना
explainEn: The primary role of the judiciary is to act as an independent arbiter for resolving legal disputes and interpreting constitutional provisions.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Political Science - Indian Constitution at Work

qEn: Bihu is a traditional dance associated with which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू किस भारतीय राज्य से संबंधित एक पारंपरिक नृत्य है?
explainEn: Bihu is a folk dance from Assam associated with the Bihu festival.

qEn: Which of the following gases is most abundant in the Earth atmosphere?
qHi: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी गैस सबसे प्रचुर मात्रा में है?
explainEn: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of the Earth atmosphere.

qEn: At which of the following sessions did the Indian National Congress split into Moderates and Extremists?
qHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस किस अधिवेशन में नरम दल और गरम दल में विभाजित हो गई थी?
explainEn: The Indian National Congress split into two groups, Moderates and Extremists, at the Surat session in 1907, presided over by Rash Behari Ghosh.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: Which of the following atmospheric layers is primarily responsible for the reflection of radio waves back to the Earth?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वायुमंडलीय परत रेडियो तरंगों को वापस पृथ्वी पर परावर्तित करने के लिए मुख्य रूप से जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: The thermosphere contains the ionosphere, which is characterized by the presence of electrically charged ions that reflect radio waves back to Earth.

qEn: Under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) structure in India, which constitutional amendment act introduced GST?
qHi: भारत में वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) ढांचे के तहत, किस संवैधानिक संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा GST की शुरुआत की गई थी?
explainEn: The 101st Constitution Amendment Act, 2016 introduced the Goods and Services Tax in India, establishing Article 246A.
sourceHint: Constitution of India, Ministry of Law and Justice

qEn: Which committee was appointed by the Reserve Bank of India to suggest measures on the revision of the Monetary Policy Framework?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक द्वारा मौद्रिक नीति फ्रेमवर्क के संशोधन पर सुझाव देने के लिए किस समिति को नियुक्त किया गया था?
explainEn: The Expert Committee to Revise and Strengthen the Monetary Policy Framework, headed by Urjit Patel, submitted its report in 2014.

qEn: During the British colonial period, the Bardoli Satyagraha of 1928 was primarily organized to protest against which of the following?
qHi: ब्रिटिश औपনিবেশिक काल के दौरान, 1928 का बारदोली सत्याग्रह मुख्य रूप से निम्नलिखित में से किसके विरोध में आयोजित किया गया था?
explainEn: The Bardoli Satyagraha was a major movement in Gujarat led by Vallabhbhai Patel against the 30% increase in land revenue imposed by the colonial government.

qEn: Under the Mauryan administration, the official responsible for the collection of revenue from all parts of the empire was known as:
qHi: मौर्य प्रशासन के अंतर्गत, साम्राज्य के सभी भागों से राजस्व एकत्र करने के लिए उत्तरदायी अधिकारी को क्या कहा जाता था?
explainEn: In Kautilya's Arthashastra, the Samaharta was the chief collector of revenue for the Mauryan state, while Sannidhata was the chief treasurer.

qEn: Which amendment of the Constitution of India introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST)?
qHi: भारत के संविधान के किस संशोधन द्वारा वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) की शुरुआत की गई थी?
explainEn: The Constitution (101st Amendment) Act, 2016, introduced the Goods and Services Tax in India, establishing a unified indirect tax framework.
sourceHint: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

qEn: Which biogeographic zone of India encompasses the Thar Desert region?
qHi: भारत का कौन सा जैव-भौगोलिक क्षेत्र थार मरुस्थल क्षेत्र को शामिल करता है?
explainEn: Wildlife Institute of India classifies the biogeographic zones into ten categories, with the Thar Desert region falling under the Indian Desert zone.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, the term 'Marginal Standing Facility' (MSF) refers to a system where scheduled commercial banks can borrow funds from the central bank by pledging:
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, 'सीमांत स्थायी सुविधा' (MSF) उस प्रणाली को संदर्भित करती है जहाँ अनुसूचित वाणिज्यिक बैंक निम्नलिखित को गिरवी रखकर केंद्रीय बैंक से धन उधार ले सकते हैं:
explainEn: MSF allows banks to borrow overnight from the RBI up to a certain percentage of their net demand and time liabilities by dipping into their Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) portfolio.

qEn: Who among the following was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty according to the Puranic chronology and epigraphic records?
qHi: पुराणों की कालक्रम और अभिलेखीय साक्ष्यों के अनुसार निम्नलिखित में से कौन सातवाहन वंश का संस्थापक था?
explainEn: Simukha is mentioned in the inscriptions and Puranas as the founder of the Satavahana dynasty, which ruled parts of central and southern India.

qEn: Which vitamin is abundant in citrus fruits like lemons and oranges?
qHi: नींबू और संतरे जैसे खट्टे फलों में कौन सा विटामिन प्रचुर मात्रा में पाया जाता है?
explainEn: Citrus fruits are rich sources of Vitamin C, also known as ascorbic acid.

qEn: Where is the headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India located?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
explainEn: The Central Office of the Reserve Bank of India was initially established in Kolkata but was permanently moved to Mumbai in 1937.

qEn: Which battle marked the definitive defeat of the Maratha Empire by the British East India Company?
qHi: किस युद्ध ने ब्रिटिश ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी द्वारा मराठा साम्राज्य की निर्णायक हार को चिह्नित किया?
explainEn: The Third Anglo-Maratha War (1817-1818) led to the collapse of the Maratha Empire and British supremacy in India.

qEn: Which standard parallel is used as the Indian Standard Time (IST) meridian?
qHi: भारतीय मानक समय (IST) मेरिडियन के रूप में किस मानक देशांतर का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: The Indian Standard Time is calculated on the basis of 82.5 degree E longitude, passing through Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh.

qEn: Which Vitamin is also known as Ascorbic Acid?
qHi: किस विटामिन को एस्कॉर्बिक एसिड के नाम से भी जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Vitamin C is a water-soluble vitamin chemically known as Ascorbic acid, found in citrus fruits.

qEn: Who wrote the famous ancient Indian treatise on statecraft, 'Arthashastra'?
qHi: राजनीति पर प्रसिद्ध प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ 'अर्थशास्त्र' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Arthashastra was authored by Chanakya (also known as Kautilya or Vishnugupta), the chief minister of Chandragupta Maurya.

qEn: Which biosphere reserve is located at the tri-junction of Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka?
qHi: केरल, तमिलनाडु और कर्नाटक के त्रिसंगम पर कौन सा बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व स्थित है?
explainEn: The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve is India's first biosphere reserve, spanning the states of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

qEn: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Supreme Court empowered to review its own judgments or orders?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान کے کس آرٹیکل کے تحت سپریم کورٹ کو اپنے ہی فیصلوں یا احکامات پر نظرثانی کرنے کا اختیار حاصل ہے؟
explainEn: Article 137 of the Constitution of India grants the Supreme Court the power to review any judgment pronounced or order made by it.

qEn: Which Harappan site is characterized by the presence of a dockyard and evidence of maritime trade?
qHi: کون سا ہڑپائی مقام گودی (ڈاک یارڈ) کی موجودگی اور سمندری تجارت کے شواہد کی وجہ سے پہچانا جاتا ہے؟
explainEn: Lothal, located in Gujarat, features a massive brick basin identified by archaeologists as a dockyard, indicating significant maritime trade.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, what does MSF stand for?
qHi: بھارتی مالیاتی پالیسی کے تناظر میں ایم ایس ایف (MSF) سے کیا مراد ہے؟
explainEn: MSF stands for Marginal Standing Facility, a window for scheduled banks to borrow overnight from the RBI in emergency situations.

qEn: Which layer of the atmosphere is primarily responsible for the reflection of radio waves back to the Earth?
qHi: محیط کا کون سا طبقہ بنیادی طور پر ریڈیو لہروں کو زمین پر واپس منعکس کرنے کا ذمہ دار ہے؟
explainEn: The thermosphere contains the ionosphere, which is ionized by solar radiation and reflects radio waves back to the Earth.

qEn: Which Mauryan rock edict contains the famous declaration: All men are my children?
qHi: موریہ دور کے کس چٹانی فرمان میں یہ مشہور اعلان درج ہے: تمام مرد میرے بچے ہیں؟
explainEn: The Separate Kalinga Edict I (also known as Dhauli/Jaugada edict) contains Asoka's statement that all men are his children.

qEn: Which plant hormone is primarily responsible for inducing dormancy in seeds and buds and helping plants withstand desiccation?
qHi: کونسا پودوں کا ہارمون بنیادی طور پر بیجوں اور کلیوں میں خوابیدہگی پیدا کرنے اور پودوں کو سوکھنے سے بچانے میں مدد کرتا ہے؟
explainEn: Abscisic Acid (ABA) acts as a general plant growth inhibitor, stimulating the closure of stomata and inducing seed dormancy.

qEn: Which river flows through the city of Surat in Gujarat?
qHi: गुजरात के सूरत शहर से कौन सी नदी बहती है?
explainEn: The city of Surat is situated on the banks of the Tapi River.

qEn: Which of the following is the chief ore of aluminum?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एल्यूमीनियम का मुख्य अयस्क है?
explainEn: Bauxite is a sedimentary rock with a high aluminum content and is the principal ore of aluminum.
