qEn: During the British colonial period in India, the Doctrine of Lapse was prominently used to annex which of the following princely states in the year 1848?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक काल के दौरान, वर्ष 1848 में निम्नलिखित में से किस रियासत का विलय करने के लिए व्यपगत के सिद्धांत (डॉक्ट्रिन ऑफ लैप्स) का प्रमुखता से उपयोग किया गया था?
explainEn: Satara was the first princely state annexed by Lord Dalhousie under the Doctrine of Lapse in 1848.

qEn: What is the primary objective of the 'Ramsar Convention', to which India is a contracting party?
qHi: 'रामसर कन्वेंशन', जिसका भारत एक पक्षकार है, का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
optsEn: Conservation and sustainable use of wetlands
Regulation of international trade in endangered species
optsHi: आर्द्रभूमि (वेटलैंड्स) का संरक्षण और सतत उपयोग
सीमा पार वायु प्रदूषण में कमी
लुप्तप्राय प्रजातियों के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार का विनियमन
समताप मंडल ओजोन परत की सुरक्षा
explainEn: The Ramsar Convention is an international treaty for the conservation and sustainable use of wetlands, signed in 1971 in Ramsar, Iran.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which institution is legally mandated to regulate the issuance of bank notes and maintain reserves with a view to securing monetary stability?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, किस संस्था को कानूनी रूप से बैंक नोटों के निर्गमन को विनियमित करने और मौद्रिक स्थिरता सुरक्षित करने के उद्देश्य से भंडार बनाए रखने का आदेश दिया गया है?
optsEn: Securities and Exchange Board of India
explainEn: Under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, the RBI is entrusted with the statutory responsibility of banknote issuance and monetary stability.

qEn: Which physiographic division of India is structurally a stable block composed of ancient gneisses and granites, forming part of the Indo-African shield?
qHi: भारत का कौन सा भौतिक विभाजन संरचनात्मक रूप से प्राचीन नीस और ग्रेनाइट से बना एक स्थिर ब्लॉक है, जो इंडो-अफ्रीकी शील्ड का हिस्सा है?
explainEn: The Peninsular Plateau is a tableland composed of the old crystalline, igneous and metamorphic rocks, forming a stable shield area.

qEn: Under the Government of India Act 1919, which of the following subjects was categorized as 'Transferred' rather than 'Reserved' in the provinces?
qHi: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1919 के तहत, प्रांतों में निम्नलिखित में से किस विषय को 'आरक्षित' के बजाय 'हस्तांतरित' के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया था?
explainEn: Dyarchy introduced provincial subjects as Reserved (administered by Governor and executive council) and Transferred (administered by ministers responsible to legislature). Education was a transferred subject.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth / NCERT

qEn: Which of the following elements is a metalloid commonly used in the manufacture of semiconductor devices in the electronics industry?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा तत्व एक उपधातु (मेटलॉइड) है जिसका उपयोग इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स उद्योग में सेमीकंडक्टर उपकरणों के निर्माण में आम तौर पर किया जाता है?
explainEn: Silicon is a chemical element with symbol Si and atomic number 14. It is a tetravalent metalloid and semiconductor widely used in computer chips.

qEn: In statistical mechanics and thermodynamics, which law states that the entropy of a pure crystalline substance approaches zero as the temperature approaches absolute zero?
qHi: सांख्यिकी यांत्रिकी और ऊष्मागतिकी में, कौन सा नियम यह बताता है कि तापमान के परम शून्य (एब्सोल्यूट जीरो) के करीब पहुंचने पर एक शुद्ध क्रिस्टलीय पदार्थ की एंट्रोपी शून्य के करीब हो जाती है?
explainEn: The Third Law of Thermodynamics states that the entropy of a system at absolute zero is a well-defined constant, typically zero for a perfect crystal.

qEn: Which historical monument was built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan as a mausoleum for his wife Mumtaz Mahal?
qHi: मुगल सम्राट शाहजहाँ ने अपनी पत्नी मुमताज महल के मकबरे के रूप में किस ऐतिहासिक स्मारक का निर्माण करवाया था?
explainEn: The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the right bank of the river Yamuna in Agra, built by Shah Jahan.

qEn: Which plateau lies between the Aravali and the Vindhya ranges?
qHi: अरावली और विंध्य श्रेणियों के बीच कौन सा पठार स्थित है?
explainEn: The Malwa Plateau is bounded by the Central Highlands in the west, the Aravali range in the north, and the Vindhya range in the south.

qEn: Which of the following elements has the lowest atomic number among the halogens?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस हैलोजन तत्व की परमाणु संख्या सबसे कम है?
explainEn: Fluorine is the lightest halogen with an atomic number of 9, placed at the top of group 17 in the periodic table.

qEn: What is the primary commercial use of Bakelite in manufacturing?
qHi: निर्माण में बेकेलाइट का प्राथमिक व्यावसायिक उपयोग क्या है?
explainEn: Bakelite is a thermosetting phenol formaldehyde resin valued for its electrical non-conductivity and heat-resistant properties, making it ideal for electrical switches and insulators.

qEn: In the context of ancient Indian history, what was the primary function of the officers known as 'Sannidhata' in the Mauryan administration?
qHi: प्राचीन भारतीय इतिहास के संदर्भ में, मौर्य प्रशासन में 'सन्निधातृ' के रूप में जाने जाने वाले अधिकारियों का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
optsEn: Chief Judge of the supreme court
Custodian of the royal treasury and storehouse
optsHi: शाही खजाने और भंडार गृह का संरक्षक
explainEn: In the Mauryan central administration, the Samaharta was the chief collector of revenue, while the Sannidhata was the officer in charge of the treasury (Koshagara) and storehouse.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Themes in Indian History Part I

qEn: Which specific economic indicator is measured using the Lorenz curve and the Gini coefficient?
qHi: लोरेंज वक्र और गिनी गुणांक का उपयोग करके किस विशिष्ट आर्थिक संकेतक को मापा जाता है?
explainEn: The Lorenz curve is a graphical representation of income distribution, and the Gini coefficient is a summary measure of income inequality derived from the Lorenz curve.

qEn: During the British colonial period in India, the 'Public Safety Bill' was primarily aimed at achieving which of the following objectives?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक काल के दौरान, 'पब्लिक सेफ्टी बिल' का मुख्य उद्देश्य निम्नलिखित में से क्या प्राप्त करना था?
optsEn: Regulating safety standards in coal mines and factories
Deporting foreign communists and socialists suspected of anti-British activities
Censoring vernacular newspapers criticizing the executive branch
Establishing municipal police forces in major presidency towns
optsHi: कोयला खदानों और कारखानियों में सुरक्षा मानकों को विनियमित करना
ब्रिटिश विरोधी गतिविधियों के संदिग्ध विदेशी कम्युनिस्टों और समाजवादियों को देश से निकालना
कार्यपालिका की आलोचना करने वाले देशी समाचार पत्रों की सेंसरशिप करना
प्रमुख प्रेसीडेंसी शहरों में नगरपालिका पुलिस बलों की स्थापना करना
explainEn: The Public Safety Bill was introduced by the colonial government in 1928 to curb the spread of communist and socialist ideas by empowering the government to deport foreign agitators.
sourceHint: A Brief History of Modern India by Rajiv Ahir (Spectrum)

qEn: Which biogeochemical cycle does not have a significant gaseous phase in the atmosphere under normal Earth conditions?
qHi: सामान्य पृथ्वी की परिस्थितियों में किस जैव-भू-रासायनिक चक्र का वायुमंडल में कोई महत्वपूर्ण गैसीय चरण नहीं होता है?
explainEn: Phosphorus is a sedimentary cycle and does not have a significant gaseous phase in the atmosphere, unlike carbon, nitrogen, and oxygen which have prominent atmospheric reservoirs.

qEn: Which Indian state enacted the first comprehensive Right to Public Services Act in the country to guarantee delivery of time-bound services to citizens?
qHi: किस भारतीय राज्य ने नागरिकों को समयबद्ध सेवाओं की डिलीवरी की गारंटी देने के लिए देश का पहला व्यापक सार्वजनिक सेवा अधिकार अधिनियम बनाया था?
explainEn: Madhya Pradesh became the first state in India to enact the Right to Public Services Act in 2010, ensuring delivery of designated services to citizens within a stipulated time frame.
sourceHint: Administrative Reforms Commission Reports / PRS Legislative Research

qEn: In stellar astrophysics, what term is used to describe the absolute upper mass limit for white dwarf stars beyond which they cannot resist gravitational collapse?
qHi: तारकीय खगोल भौतिकी में, श्वेत वामन (white dwarf) तारों के लिए उस पूर्ण ऊपरी द्रव्यमान सीमा को क्या कहा जाता है जिसके आगे वे गुरुत्वाकर्षण पतन का विरोध नहीं कर सकते?
explainEn: The Chandrasekhar limit is approximately 1.4 times the mass of the Sun and is the maximum mass of a stable white dwarf star, calculated by Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar.

qEn: Who founded the Arya Samaj in the year 1875?
qHi: वर्ष 1875 में आर्य समाज की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in Bombay on April 10, 1875.

qEn: Which atmospheric layer is primarily responsible for the reflection of radio waves back to Earth?
qHi: कौन सी वायुमंडलीय परत मुख्य रूप से रेडियो तरंगों को वापस पृथ्वी पर परावर्तित करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: The thermosphere contains the ionosphere, which is abundant in electrically charged ions and free electrons that reflect radio waves.

qEn: Which Gupta ruler is depicted on his coins playing the veena (lute)?
qHi: किस गुप्त शासक को उसके सिक्कों पर वीणा बजाते हुए दर्शाया गया है?
explainEn: Samudragupta issued gold coins of the 'lyrist type' showing him playing the veena, indicating his patronage of music and arts.

qEn: The 'Right to Education' became a fundamental right in India under which Constitutional Amendment Act?
qHi: भारत में 'शिक्षा का अधिकार' किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम के तहत मौलिक अधिकार बना?
explainEn: The 86th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2002 inserted Article 21A, making education for children aged 6 to 14 years a fundamental right.

qEn: Which amendment of the Constitution of India lowered the voting age from 21 years to 18 years?
qHi: भारत के संविधान के किस संशोधन ने मतदान की आयु 21 वर्ष से घटाकर 18 वर्ष कर दी?
explainEn: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 lowered the voting age of elections to the Lok Sabha and Legislative Assemblies from 21 to 18 years.

qEn: Which of the following classical dance forms originated in Kerala?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा शास्त्रीय नृत्य रूप केरल में उत्पन्न हुआ?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance that originated in the southern state of Kerala.

qEn: Who is regarded as the Father of the Indian Constitution?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के जनक के रूप में किसे माना जाता है?
explainEn: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly.

qEn: Which line of latitude passes almost midway through India?
qHi: कौन सी अक्षांश रेखा लगभग भारत के बीचों-बीच से गुजरती है?
explainEn: The Tropic of Cancer (23.30 degrees N) passes through the middle of India, covering eight states.

qEn: Kuchipudi is a classical dance form originating from which Indian state?
qHi: कुचिपुड़ी किस भारतीय राज्य से उत्पन्न होने वाला शास्त्रीय नृत्य रूप है?
explainEn: Kuchipudi is one of the eight major Indian classical dances and originates from Andhra Pradesh.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: Which plateau is situated between the Aravalli and Vindhya ranges?
qHi: अरावली और विंध्य श्रेणियों के बीच कौन सा पठार स्थित है?
explainEn: The Malwa Plateau is bounded by the Aravalli range in the west and the Vindhya range in the south.

qEn: Which Gupta ruler assumed the title of 'Kaviraja' due to his proficiency in music and poetry?
qHi: किस गुप्त शासक को संगीत और कविता में दक्षता के कारण 'कविराज' की उपाधि दी गई थी?
explainEn: Samudragupta is depicted playing the veena on his coins and is described as 'Kaviraja' in the Allahabad Pillar inscription.

qEn: Which organization in India calculates the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) at the national level?
qHi: भारत में राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) की गणना कौन सा संगठन करता है?
explainEn: The National Statistical Office (NSO), under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, is responsible for macro-economic data collection including GDP calculation.
sourceHint: PIB / Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

qEn: Which historical monument is known as the symbol of love and built by Emperor Shah Jahan?
qHi: किस ऐतिहासिक स्मारक को प्रेम का प्रतीक माना जाता है और इसे सम्राट शाहजहाँ ने बनवाया था?
explainEn: The Taj Mahal in Agra was commissioned by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan as a mausoleum for his wife Mumtaz Mahal.

qEn: What is the minimum age requirement for a person to be elected as a member of the Lok Sabha in India?
qHi: भारत में लोकसभा के सदस्य के रूप में चुने जाने के लिए व्यक्ति की न्यूनतम आयु सीमा क्या है?
explainEn: According to Article 84 of the Constitution, the minimum age for Lok Sabha is 25 years.

qEn: Which gas makes up the largest share of Earth's atmosphere by volume?
qHi: आयतन के हिसाब से पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में किस गैस की हिस्सेदारी सबसे अधिक है?
explainEn: Nitrogen constitutes about 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere by volume.

qEn: Which amendment of the Indian Constitution lowered the voting age from 21 years to 18 years?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस संशोधन द्वारा मतदान की आयु 21 वर्ष से घटाकर 18 वर्ष कर दी गई थी?
explainEn: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988, lowered the voting age of elections to the Lok Sabha and Legislative Assemblies from 21 to 18 years.

qEn: In which state is the Loktak Lake, famous for its floating phumdis, situated?
qHi: अपने तैरते हुए फुमदी के लिए प्रसिद्ध लोकतक झील किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Loktak Lake is the largest freshwater lake in Northeast India, located in Manipur, and is famous for the phumdis (floating heterogeneous mass of vegetation) floating over it.

qEn: Which metal is commonly known as quicksilver due to its liquid state at room temperature?
qHi: किस धातु को कमरे के तापमान पर उसकी तरल अवस्था के कारण सामान्यतः क्विकसिलवर कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Mercury is a chemical element with the symbol Hg and atomic number 80. It is heavily known as quicksilver and is liquid at standard temperature and pressure.

qEn: The classical dance form named Kathakali originated in which Indian state?
qHi: कथकली नामक शास्त्रीय नृत्य शैली की उत्पत्ति किस भारतीय राज्य में हुई थी?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance that originated in the southern state of Kerala.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: The Tropic of Cancer does not pass through which of the following Indian states?
qHi: कर्क रेखा निम्नलिखित में से किस भारतीय राज्य से होकर नहीं गुजरती है?
explainEn: The Tropic of Cancer passes through eight Indian states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram. It does not pass through Odisha.

qEn: Which dynasty constructed the famous Kailash Temple at Ellora?
qHi: इलोरा में प्रसिद्ध कैलाश मंदिर का निर्माण किस राजवंश ने करवाया था?
explainEn: The rock-cut Kailash Temple (Cave 16) at Ellora was built by the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I in the 8th century.

qEn: What is the primary commercial crop grown in the black soils (Regur soil) of India?
qHi: भारत की काली मिट्टी (रेगुर मिट्टी) में उगाई जाने वाली प्रमुख व्यावसायिक फसल कौन सी है?
explainEn: Black soil is ideal for growing cotton due to its high moisture retention capacity, which is why it is also known as black cotton soil.

qEn: Who was the first woman President of the Indian National Congress?
qHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस की पहली महिला अध्यक्ष कौन थीं?
explainEn: Annie Besant was the first woman President of the Indian National Congress, presiding over the Calcutta session in 1917.

qEn: Which of the following writs is issued by a higher court to a lower court or tribunal to prevent exceeding its jurisdiction?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी रिट किसी उच्च न्यायालय द्वारा निचली अदालत या न्यायाधिकरण को उसकी अधिकार क्षेत्र से बाहर जाने से रोकने के लिए जारी की जाती है?
explainEn: The writ of Prohibition is literally meant 'to forbid'. It is issued by a higher court to a lower court or tribunal to prevent them from exceeding their jurisdiction.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth, Chapter on Fundamental Rights

qEn: During the Gupta period, what was the primary tax levied on agricultural produce, typically fixed at one-sixth of the produce?
qHi: गुप्त काल के दौरान, कृषि उपज पर लगाया जाने वाला प्रमुख कर क्या था, जो आमतौर पर उपज का छठा हिस्सा तय किया जाता था?
explainEn: Bhaga was the main land revenue tax in ancient India, particularly during the Gupta period, usually amounting to one-sixth of the total agricultural produce.

qEn: What is the primary function of the 'Coriolis force' in relation to global wind patterns?
qHi: वैश्विक पवन पैटर्न के संबंध में 'कोरिolis बल' का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: It alters the speed of the wind
It deflects the wind to the right in the Northern Hemisphere
It generates the initial pressure gradient
It destroys wind energy near the equator
optsHi: यह हवा की गति को बदलता है
यह उत्तरी गोलार्ध में हवा को दाईं ओर विक्षेपित करता है
यह प्रारंभिक दबाव प्रवणता उत्पन्न करता है
यह भूमध्य रेखा के पास पवन ऊर्जा को नष्ट करता है
explainEn: The Coriolis force deflects winds to the right in the Northern Hemisphere and to the left in the Southern Hemisphere, without affecting wind speed directly.

qEn: Which organism is primarily responsible for the biological fixation of atmospheric nitrogen in leguminous root nodules?
qHi: दलहनी पौधों की जड़ों की गांठों में वायुमंडलीय नाइट्रोजन के जैविक स्थिरीकरण के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा जीव जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Rhizobium bacteria form a symbiotic relationship with the root nodules of leguminous plants to fix atmospheric nitrogen.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which institution is legally mandated to regulate inflation targeting under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक अधिनियम, 1934 के तहत मुद्रास्फीति लक्षित करने के लिए किस संस्था को कानूनी रूप से अधिकृत किया गया है?
optsEn: Securities and Exchange Board of India
explainEn: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) was constituted under Section 45ZB of the RBI Act, 1934, to determine the policy interest rate required to achieve the inflation target.

qEn: Who established the Asiatic Society of Bengal in Kolkata in the year 1784?
qHi: वर्ष 1784 में कोलकाता में एशियाटिक सोसाइटी ऑफ़ बंगाल की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Sir William Jones established the Asiatic Society of Bengal on January 15, 1784, to encourage oriental studies in India.

qEn: Which vitamin is chemically known as Cyanocobalamin and contains the transition metal cobalt?
qHi: किस विटामिन को रासायनिक रूप से साइनोकोबलामिन के रूप में जाना जाता है और इसमें संक्रमण धातु कोबाल्ट होता है?
explainEn: Vitamin B12 is chemically called cyanocobalamin and is unique among vitamins for containing the metal ion cobalt.

qEn: Which vitamin is primarily synthesized by the human body upon exposure to sunlight?
qHi: सूर्य के प्रकाश के संपर्क में आने पर मानव शरीर द्वारा मुख्य रूप से कौन सा विटामिन संश्लेषित होता है?
explainEn: Vitamin D is produced in the skin when exposed to ultraviolet B (UVB) rays from sunlight.

qEn: Who wrote the ancient Indian treatise on statecraft, Arthashastra?
qHi: राजव्यवस्था पर प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ 'अर्थशास्त्र' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Arthashastra was authored by Kautilya, also known as Chanakya.

qEn: During the Gupta period, the land revenue collected from the cultivators was generally fixed at which fraction of the produce?
qHi: गुप्त काल के दौरान, किसानों से एकत्र किया जाने वाला भू-राजस्व आमतौर पर उपज के किस भाग पर तय किया जाता था?
explainEn: In the Gupta empire, land revenue was the chief source of income for the state and was generally fixed at one-sixth (Shadbhaga) of the total produce.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Themes in Indian History Part I

qEn: Which of the following movements was suspended by Mahatma Gandhi in the wake of the Chauri Chaura incident?
qHi: चौरी चौरा घटना के बाद महात्मा गांधी ने निम्नलिखित में से किस आंदोलन को स्थगित कर दिया था?
explainEn: Mahatma Gandhi called off the Non-Cooperation Movement in February 1922 following the violent Chauri Chaura incident in Gorakhpur district.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of a Finance Commission of India?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद भारत के वित्त आयोग की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 280 of the Indian Constitution provides for a Finance Commission as a quasi-judicial body to define financial relations between the Centre and the states.

qEn: Which vitamin is essential for the normal blood clotting process in human beings?
qHi: मनुष्यों में सामान्य रक्त थक्का जमने की प्रक्रिया के लिए कौन सा विटामिन आवश्यक है?
explainEn: Vitamin K plays a major role in blood clotting, bone metabolism, and regulating blood calcium levels.

qEn: The Rourkela Steel Plant was established in the Indian state of Odisha with the technical and financial collaboration of which country?
qHi: ओडिशा राज्य में राउरकेला इस्पात संयंत्र की स्थापना किस देश के तकनीकी और वित्तीय सहयोग से की गई थी?
explainEn: Rourkela Steel Plant, set up in the public sector, was established in collaboration with West Germany during the Second Five-Year Plan.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 10 Economics - Understanding Economic Development

qEn: During the reign of which Delhi Sultanate ruler was the department of slaves known as 'Diwan-i-Bandagan' created?
qHi: दिल्ली सल्तनत के किस शासक के शासनकाल में 'दीवान-ए-बदगान' नामक दासों के विभाग की स्थापना की गई थी?
explainEn: Firuz Shah Tughlaq established the Diwan-i-Bandagan specifically to take care of his vast collection of slaves.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 7 History, Our Pasts II

qEn: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Parliament empowered to regulate the right of citizenship by law?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत संसद को कानून द्वारा नागरिकता के अधिकार को विनियमित करने की शक्ति दी गई है?
explainEn: Article 11 of the Constitution explicitly grants Parliament the power to make provisions regarding the acquisition and termination of citizenship and all other matters relating to it.

qEn: Which Indian state shares the maximum length of its international border with Myanmar?
qHi: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य म्यांमार के साथ अपनी अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीमा की सबसे अधिक लंबाई साझा करता है?
explainEn: Arunachal Pradesh shares the longest border with Myanmar among the four Indian states that border Myanmar.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 9 Geography, Contemporary India I

qEn: Which site of the Indus Valley Civilization is characterized by the presence of a dockyard?
qHi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के किस स्थल की विशेषता गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) की उपस्थिति है?
explainEn: Lothal, located in Gujarat, is famous for its massive tidal dockyard, which connected the city to an ancient course of the Sabarmati river.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part I

qEn: What is the primary function of the 'Coriolis force' in relation to global winds?
qHi: वैश्विक हवाओं के संबंध में 'कोरिओलिस बल' का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: It generates wind speed by creating pressure gradients
It deflects winds to the right in the Northern hemisphere and to the left in the Southern hemisphere
It heats up the equatorial regions to cause convection
It completely halts winds at the horse latitudes
optsHi: यह दबाव प्रवणता बनाकर हवा की गति उत्पन्न करता है
यह उत्तरी गोलार्ध में हवाओं को दाईं ओर और दक्षिणी गोलार्ध में बाईं ओर विक्षेपित करता है
यह संवहन पैदा करने के लिए भूमध्यरेखीय क्षेत्रों को गर्म करता है
यह अश्व अक्षांशों पर हवाओं को पूरी तरह से रोक देता है
explainEn: The Coriolis force is an apparent force caused by the Earth's rotation that deflects moving objects, including winds, to the right in the Northern Hemisphere and to the left in the Southern Hemisphere.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography, Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of the Election Commission?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद निर्वाचन आयोग की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 324 of the Constitution of India vests the superintendence, direction, and control of elections in the Election Commission.

qEn: The Bhakra Nangal Dam is constructed across which river?
qHi: भाखड़ा नांगल बांध किस नदी पर बनाया गया है?
explainEn: The Bhakra Nangal Dam is built on the Satluj River in Himachal Pradesh and Punjab border.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the officer responsible for maintaining land revenue records and land transactions was known as:
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, भू-राजस्व रिकॉर्ड और भूमि लेनदेन को बनाए रखने के लिए जिम्मेदार अधिकारी को किस रूप में जाना जाता था?
explainEn: Pustapala was the district record keeper in the Gupta administration who maintained records of all land transactions in the district.

qEn: The ancient port city of Lothal, known for its dockyard, is situated beside which river in Gujarat?
qHi: गोदी (डockyard) के लिए प्रसिद्ध प्राचीन बंदरगाह शहर लोथल, गुजरात में किस नदी के किनारे स्थित है?
explainEn: Lothal was one of the southernmost cities of the ancient Indus Valley Civilization, located on the Bhogavo river, a tributary of Sabarmati, in the Gulf of Khambhat region of Gujarat.

qEn: Who among the following was the founder of the Servants of India Society established in 1905?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 1905 में स्थापित सर्वेंट्स ऑफ़ इंडिया सोसाइटी के संस्थापक थे?
explainEn: Gopal Krishna Gokhale founded the Servants of India Society in Pune, Maharashtra, in 1905 to unite and train Indian people from different ethnicities and religions in welfare work.
sourceHint: Modern Indian History by Bipan Chandra

qEn: What is the primary function of the 'Warrant of Precedence' in the Government of India?
qHi: भारत सरकार में 'वरीयता अनुक्रम' (Warrant of Precedence) का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: To determine the order of succession to the office of the President
To establish the hierarchical rank of important dignitaries of the State
To allocate budget shares to various Union ministries
To decide the precedence of bills introduced in Parliament
optsHi: राष्ट्रपति के पद पर उत्तराधिकार के क्रम का निर्धारण करना
राज्य के महत्वपूर्ण गणमान्य व्यक्तियों के पदानुक्रम को स्थापित करना
विभिन्न केंद्रीय मंत्रालयों को बजट हिस्सा आवंटित करना
संसद में पेश विधेयकों की प्राथमिकता तय करना
explainEn: The President's Warrant of Precedence is a protocol list that records the hierarchical rank of the top authorities and dignitaries of the Union and State governments of India.

qEn: In which year was the Non-Cooperation Movement officially launched by Mahatma Gandhi?
qHi: महात्मा गांधी द्वारा असहयोग आंदोलन आधिकारिक तौर पर किस वर्ष शुरू किया गया था?
explainEn: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in September 1920 during the Nagpur session of the Indian National Congress.

qEn: Which of the following is the highest peak in the Eastern Ghats?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी चोटी पूर्वी घाट की सबसे ऊंची चोटी है?
explainEn: Jindhagada Peak, located in the Araku Valley of Andhra Pradesh, is widely accepted as the highest peak in the Eastern Ghats.

qEn: Which vitamin is abundant in citrus fruits like lemon and orange?
qHi: नींबू और संतरा जैसे खट्टे फलों में कौन सा विटामिन प्रचुर मात्रा में होता है?
explainEn: Citrus fruits are rich sources of Vitamin C, also known as ascorbic acid.

qEn: Which chemical element is commonly known as quicksilver?
qHi: किस रासायनिक तत्व को सामान्यतः 'क्विकसिल्वर' कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Mercury is a metallic chemical element with the symbol Hg and atomic number 80, historically referred to as quicksilver.

qEn: In which state is the ancient site of Lothal situated?
qHi: प्राचीन स्थल लोथल किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Lothal was one of the southernmost cities of the ancient Indus Valley Civilization, located in the Bhal region of the modern state of Gujarat.

qEn: Which of the following vitamins is water-soluble?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा विटामिन जल में घुलनशील है?
explainEn: Vitamins are classified as either fat-soluble (A, D, E, K) or water-soluble (C and the B-complex vitamins).

qEn: What is the standard unit for measuring electric current in the International System of Units (SI)?
qHi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय इकाई प्रणाली (SI) में विद्युत धारा को मापने की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of electric current is the ampere, which is a base unit of the International System of Units.

qEn: Who founded the Satvahana dynasty according to historical Puranic sources and inscriptions?
qHi: ऐतिहासिक पौराणिक स्रोतों और अभिलेखों के अनुसार सातवाहन वंश की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Simuka is regarded as the founder of the Satavahana dynasty, which ruled parts of central and southern India.

qEn: Which wind system is primarily responsible for the winter rainfall in the northwestern part of India?
qHi: भारत के उत्तर-पश्चिमी भाग में शीतकालीन वर्षा के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी पवन प्रणाली उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: Western Disturbances are extratropical storms originating in the Mediterranean region that bring winter rain to northwestern India.

qEn: Which institution acts as the regulator for the stock market in India?
qHi: भारत में शेयर बाजार के विनियामक के रूप में कौन सी संस्था कार्य करती है?
explainEn: SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) is the regulatory body for securities and commodity market in India.

qEn: The atmospheric layer in which temperature increases sharply with height due to absorption of ultraviolet radiation by ozone is the:
qHi: वह वायुमंडलीय परत जिसमें ओजोन द्वारा पराबैंगनी विकिरण के अवशोषण के कारण ऊंचाई के साथ तापमान तेजी से बढ़ता है, वह है:
explainEn: The stratosphere contains the ozone layer which absorbs UV radiation, causing the temperature to rise with increasing altitude.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: In which session did the Indian National Congress pass the historic Poorna Swaraj resolution?
qHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने किस अधिवेशन में ऐतिहासिक पूर्ण स्वराज का प्रस्ताव पारित किया था?
explainEn: The Lahore session of December 1929 under the presidency of Jawaharlal Nehru passed the Poorna Swaraj resolution.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 10 History - Nationalism in India

qEn: Which bio-geographical region in India contains the highest number of endemic plant species?
qHi: भारत के किस जैव-भौगोलिक क्षेत्र में स्थानिक (एंडेमिक) पादप प्रजातियों की संख्या सबसे अधिक है?
explainEn: The Western Ghats along with Sri Lanka is recognized as a global biodiversity hotspot with an exceptionally high concentration of endemic flora and fauna.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)

qEn: The dual government system (Dyarchy) in the provinces was introduced in India by which of the following acts?
qHi: प्रांतों में द्वैध शासन प्रणाली (डायर्ची) भारत में निम्नलिखित में से किस अधिनियम द्वारा शुरू की गई थी?
explainEn: The Government of India Act 1919 (Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms) introduced dyarchy in the provinces, dividing provincial subjects into transferred and reserved.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 8/12 History and Indian Polity

qEn: Which of the following is a Kharif crop grown extensively in the northern plains of India during the monsoon season?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक खरीफ फसल है जो मानसून के मौसम में भारत के उत्तरी मैदानों में बड़े पैमाने पर उगाई जाती है?
explainEn: Maize is a Kharif crop that requires temperatures between 21°C to 27°C and grows well in old alluvial soil, sown with the onset of monsoon.

qEn: Which of the following Fundamental Rights is guaranteed under Article 21 of the Constitution of India?
qHi: भारत के संविधान के अनुच्छेद 21 के तहत निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार की गारंटी दी गई है?
optsEn: Right to Life and Personal Liberty
optsHi: प्राण और दैहिक स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार
explainEn: Article 21 of the Indian Constitution states that no person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

qEn: Which state in India has the coastline along the Arabian Sea?
qHi: भारत के किस राज्य की तटरेखा अरब सागर के साथ लगती है?
explainEn: Gujarat is located on the western coast of India and shares its coastline with the Arabian Sea.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, what was the primary function of an officer known as 'Kumaramatyas'?
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, 'कुमारमात्य' नामक अधिकारी का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
optsEn: Chief judicial administration in rural courts
Important administrative functionaries directly recruited by the king
optsHi: ग्रामीण न्यायालयों में मुख्य न्यायिक प्रशासन
राजा द्वारा सीधे नियुक्त किए जाने वाले महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक पदाधिकारी
घुड़सवार सेना इकाइयों के मुख्य कमांडर
explainEn: Kumaramatyas were the most important class of imperial officers in the Gupta administration, often attached to provinces or crown princes.

qEn: Which of the following constitutional amendments added the Fundamental Duties to the Indian Constitution?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस संविधान संशोधन ने भारतीय संविधान में मौलिक कर्तव्यों को जोड़ा?
explainEn: Fundamental Duties were incorporated into Part IV-A of the Constitution by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976, on the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee.

qEn: Which type of coal contains the highest carbon content and burns with the least smoke?
qHi: किस प्रकार के कोयले में कार्बन की मात्रा सबसे अधिक होती है और यह सबसे कम धुएं के साथ जलता है?
explainEn: Anthracite is the highest grade of coal, containing 80 to 95 percent carbon, burning cleanly with little smoke.

qEn: What is the primary function of the 'Stomata' in plant leaves?
qHi: पौधे की पत्तियों में 'रंध्र' (स्टोमेटा) का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: Exchange of gases during photosynthesis and respiration
Storage of water reserves during drought
Providing structural rigidity to the leaf veins
optsHi: मिट्टी के पोषक तत्वों का अवशोषण
प्रकाश संश्लेषण और श्वसन के दौरान गैसों का आदान-प्रदान
सूखे के दौरान जल भंडार का भंडारण
पत्ती की नसों को संरचनात्मक कठोरता प्रदान करना
explainEn: Stomata are tiny pores on plant leaves that facilitate gaseous exchange (oxygen and carbon dioxide) and transpiration.

qEn: During the reign of which Delhi Sultan was the 'Diwan-i-Kohi', a department dedicated to agriculture, created?
qHi: किस दिल्ली सल्तनत के शासक के शासनकाल में कृषि को समर्पित विभाग 'दीवान-ए-कोही' बनाया गया था?
explainEn: Muhammad bin Tughlaq created the Diwan-i-Kohi to improve agricultural land and provide direct state aid to farmers.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 7 History, Our Pasts II

qEn: Which type of wave is used by bats to navigate and locate obstacles in complete darkness?
qHi: पूर्ण अंधकार में नेविगेट करने और बाधाओं का पता लगाने के लिए चमगादड़ किस प्रकार की तरंग का उपयोग करते हैं?
explainEn: Bats use echolocation by emitting high-frequency ultrasonic waves to detect objects and prey.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 9 Science, Chapter on Sound

qEn: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many states of India?
qHi: कर्क रेखा भारत के कितने राज्यों से होकर गुजरती है?
explainEn: The Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 Indian states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 9 Geography, Contemporary India I

qEn: Which committee recommended the establishment of a three-tier Panchayati Raj system in India?
qHi: किस समिति ने भारत में त्रिस्तरीय पंचायती राज व्यवस्था की स्थापना की सिफारिश की थी?
explainEn: The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee (1957) recommended a three-tier Panchayati Raj system consisting of Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti, and Zilla Parishad.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth, Panchayati Raj Chapter

qEn: Which metal was primarily used to make coins during the Gupta period?
qHi: गुप्त काल के दौरान सिक्के बनाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता था?
explainEn: The Gupta dynasty issued a large number of gold coins, known as Dinaras, which are noted for their fine workmanship.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, the Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) was introduced by the Reserve Bank of India in which year?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक द्वारा सीमांत स्थायी सुविधा (MSF) किस वर्ष शुरू की गई थी?
explainEn: The Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) was introduced by the RBI in its monetary policy statement for 2011-12 to allow scheduled commercial banks to borrow overnight funds.

qEn: Which of the following soils is formed due to intense leaching under tropical conditions with alternate wet and dry periods?
qHi: वैकल्पिक गीली और सूखी अवधि के साथ उष्णकटिबंधीय परिस्थितियों में तीव्र निक्षालन (लीचिंग) के कारण निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी मिट्टी बनती है?
explainEn: Laterite soils develop in areas with high temperature and heavy rainfall, which cause intense leaching, washing away silica and leaving iron and aluminium oxides.

qEn: Who among the following was the founder of the Satyashodhak Samaj, established in 1873?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 1873 में स्थापित सत्यशोधक समाज के संस्थापक थे?
explainEn: Jyotirao Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj (Society of Seekers of Truth) on 24 September 1873 to advocate for the rights of depressed classes.

qEn: Which organelle in a eukaryotic cell contains its own independent circular DNA and 70S ribosomes?
qHi: यूकेरियोटिक कोशिका के किस अंगक में अपना स्वतंत्र गोलाकार डीएनए और 70S राइबोसोम होते हैं?
explainEn: Mitochondria (and chloroplasts) possess their own circular DNA and 70S ribosomes, supporting the endosymbiotic theory.

qEn: The historic Lahore Session of the Indian National Congress in 1929 was presided over by whom?
qHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के 1929 के ऐतिहासिक लाहौर अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी?
explainEn: Jawaharlal Nehru presided over the Lahore session of the INC in December 1929, where the Purna Swaraj resolution was passed.

qEn: Which state in India is well known for the classical dance form Kathakali?
qHi: भारत का कौन सा राज्य कथकली शास्त्रीय नृत्य शैली के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major classical Indian dance form that originated in the southern state of Kerala.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: Where is the headquarters of the International Court of Justice located?
qHi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय न्यायालय का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
explainEn: The International Court of Justice has its headquarters at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands.

qEn: At which of the following Indus Valley Civilization sites has a dockyard been discovered?
qHi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थल से एक गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) खोजा गया है?
explainEn: Lothal in Gujarat features a massive brick basin identified by archaeologists as a tidal dockyard.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part I

qEn: Which administrative body was established under the provisions of the Government of India Act of 1935 to oversee railway administration?
qHi: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1935 के प्रावधानों के तहत रेलवे प्रशासन की देखरेख کے लिए किस निकाय की स्थापना की गई थी?
explainEn: Section 181 of the Government of India Act 1935 provided for the establishment of a Federal Railway Authority.
sourceHint: Government of India Act 1935, Statutory Provisions

qEn: The 'Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary', famous for hosting a dense population of the great Indian one-horned rhinoceros, is located in which state?
qHi: एक सींग वाले भारतीय गैंडों की घनी आबादी के लिए प्रसिद्ध 'पोबितोरा वन्यजीव अभयारण्य' किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary is located in the Morigaon district of Assam, on the southern bank of the Brahmaputra River.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Govt of India

qEn: During the British colonial rule in India, the 'Public Safety Bill' was introduced in the Central Legislative Assembly in 1928 primarily to achieve what purpose?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन के दौरान, 1928 में केंद्रीय विधानसभा में 'पब्लिक सेफ्टी बिल' मुख्य रूप से किस उद्देश्य से लाया गया था?
optsEn: To deport foreign communists and suppress radical trade union activities
To regulate the press and curb vernacular newspapers
To establish separate electorates for depressed classes
To centralize the police force under the Viceroy
optsHi: विदेशी कम्युनिस्टों को देश से निकालने और कट्टरपंथी ट्रेड यूनियन गतिविधियों को दबाने के लिए
प्रेस को विनियमित करने और भाषाई समाचार पत्रों पर अंकुश लगाने के लिए
दलित वर्गों के लिए पृथक निर्वाचन क्षेत्र स्थापित करने के लिए
वायसराय के अधीन पुलिस बल को केंद्रीकृत करने के लिए
explainEn: The Public Safety Bill of 1928 aimed to empower the government to deport foreign communists suspected of promoting revolutionary and labor movements in India.

qEn: What is the chemical formula for water?
qHi: पानी का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: A water molecule is composed of two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom, hence H2O.

qEn: The Kaziranga National Park is famous for the conservation of which animal?
qHi: काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस जानवर के संरक्षण के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Kaziranga National Park in Assam hosts two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses.

qEn: What is the primary chemical component of natural pearls?
qHi: प्राकृतिक मोतियों का मुख्य रासायनिक घटक क्या है?
explainEn: Pearls are composed primarily of calcium carbonate in the form of aragonite or calcite, deposited in concentric layers.

qEn: Which river forms the famous Dudhsagar Falls located on the border of Goa and Karnataka?
qHi: गोगोवा और कर्नाटक की सीमा पर स्थित प्रसिद्ध दूधसागर जलप्रपात कौन सी नदी बनाती है?
explainEn: The Dudhsagar Falls is located on the Mandovi River on the Goa-Karnataka border.

qEn: Which dynasty constructed the famous Kailasa temple (Cave 16) at Ellora?
qHi: एलोरा में प्रसिद्ध कैलाश मंदिर (गुफा 16) का निर्माण किस राजवंश ने करवाया था?
explainEn: The monolithic Kailasa temple at Ellora was built during the reign of the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I in the 8th century.

qEn: What is the standard unit of measuring electrical current?
qHi: विद्युत धारा मापने की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The ampere is the SI unit of electric current.

qEn: Which wind system is primarily responsible for the rainfall in the winter season over the northwestern part of India?
qHi: भारत के उत्तर-पश्चिमी भाग में सर्दियों के मौसम में वर्षा के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी पवन प्रणाली जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Western Disturbances are extratropical storms originating in the Mediterranean region that bring sudden winter rain to the northwestern parts of the Indian subcontinent.

qEn: The Khajuraho group of monuments, known for their Nagara-style temple architecture, was built by which dynasty?
qHi: अपनी नागर शैली के मंदिर स्थापत्य के लिए प्रसिद्ध खजुराहो स्मारकों का समूह किस राजवंश द्वारा बनवाया गया था?
explainEn: The Khajuraho temples were built by the Chandela dynasty between 950 and 1050 CE in Madhya Pradesh.

qEn: During the reign of which Delhi Sultan was the 'Diwan-i-Kohi', a separate department for agriculture, established?
qHi: किस दिल्ली सल्तनत के शासक के शासनकाल में कृषि के लिए एक अलग विभाग 'दीवान-ए-कोही' की स्थापना की गई थी?
explainEn: Muhammad bin Tughlaq created the agricultural department known as Diwan-i-Kohi to bring uncultivated land under cultivation through state support.

qEn: Which Charter Act ended the commercial monopoly of the East India Company in India, except for the trade in tea and trade with China?
qHi: किस चार्टर अधिनियम ने चाय के व्यापार और चीन के साथ व्यापार को छोड़कर, भारत में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के व्यापारिक एकाधिकार को समाप्त कर दिया?
explainEn: The Charter Act of 1813 ended the Company's trade monopoly in India except for tea and trade with China, which were ended later in 1833.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth (Historical Background)

qEn: Which Indian state shares the maximum length of international land boundary?
qHi: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य अधिकतम लंबाई की अंतर्राष्ट्रीय स्थलीय सीमा साझा करता है?
explainEn: West Bengal shares the longest international land border among Indian states, primarily with Bangladesh, followed by others.
sourceHint: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

qEn: Who founded the 'Atmiya Sabha' in Calcutta in the year 1815?
qHi: वर्ष 1815 में कलकत्ता में 'आत्मीय सभा' की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Atmiya Sabha in 1815 as a philosophical discussion circle in Kolkata to campaign against social evils.
sourceHint: Modern Indian History by Bipan Chandra

qEn: Which dynasty constructed the famous rock-cut Kailasa Temple at Ellora?
qHi: एलोरा में प्रसिद्ध शैलकृत कैलाश मंदिर का निर्माण किस राजवंश ने करवाया था?
explainEn: The Kailasa temple at Ellora was built by the Rashtrakuta king Krishna I in the 8th century.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the official title 'Kumaramatyas' referred to which category of functionaries?
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, आधिकारिक उपाधि 'कुमारमात्य' किस श्रेणी के पदाधिकारियों को संदर्भित करती थी?
optsEn: High-ranking provincial and central civil officers
Royal priests in charge of religious sacrifices
Chief treasurers of the imperial treasury
optsHi: उच्च रैंकिंग वाले प्रांतीय और केंद्रीय सिविल अधिकारी
धार्मिक यज्ञों के प्रभारी शाही पुरोहित
explainEn: Kumaramatyas were the most important class of high-ranking central and provincial officers under the Guptas, directly recruited by the king and often appointed as district administrators or ministers.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which institution is legally mandated to determine the inflation target under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक अधिनियम, 1934 के तहत मुद्रास्फीति लक्ष्य निर्धारित करने के लिए कानूनी रूप से कौन सी संस्था अधिकृत है?
optsEn: Central Government in consultation with the Bank
optsHi: बैंक के परामर्श से केंद्र सरकार
मौद्रिक नीति समिति स्वतंत्र रूप से
explainEn: Under Section 45ZA of the RBI Act, 1934 (amended in 2016), the Central Government, in consultation with the Reserve Bank, determines the inflation target in terms of the Consumer Price Index once every five years.

qEn: The historic site of Kalibangan, known for its unique pre-Harappan and Harappan remains, is situated along the banks of which river?
qHi: कालीबंगा का ऐतिहासिक स्थल, जो अपने अनूठे प्राग्-हड़प्पा और हड़प्पा अवशेषों के लिए जाना जाता है, किस नदी के तट पर स्थित है?
explainEn: Kalibangan is located in Hanumangarh district, Rajasthan, on the southern banks of the Ghaggar River (identified by many scholars as the ancient Sarasvati River).
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Themes in Indian History Part I

qEn: Which among the following layers of the atmosphere is characterized by a constant decrease in temperature with increasing altitude and contains almost all the weather phenomena?
qHi: वायुमंडल की निम्नलिखित में से किस परत की विशेषता बढ़ती ऊंचाई के साथ तापमान में लगातार कमी है और इसमें लगभग सभी मौसम संबंधी घटनाएं शामिल हैं?
explainEn: The troposphere is the lowest layer of the atmosphere where temperature decreases with height at the normal lapse rate, and it contains virtually all weather processes.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: Which socio-religious organization founded in 1867 in western India campaigned actively against child marriage and advocated for widow remarriage and women's education?
qHi: पश्चिमी भारत में 1867 में स्थापित किस सामाजिक-धार्मिक संगठन ने बाल विवाह के खिलाफ सक्रिय रूप से अभियान चलाया और विधवा पुनर्विवाह और महिला शिक्षा की वकालत की?
explainEn: Prarthana Samaj was founded in Bombay in 1867 by Atmaram Pandurang with the backing of Justice Mahadeo Govind Ranade and R.G. Bhandarkar to reform Hindu religious and social practices.

qEn: In plant physiology, which plant hormone is primarily responsible for cell elongation, apical dominance, and phototropic movements?
qHi: पादप शरीर विज्ञान में, कौन सा पादप हार्मोन मुख्य रूप से कोशिका दीर्घीकरण, शीर्ष प्रमुखता और प्रकाशानुवर्ती गतियों के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Auxins are a class of plant hormones that promote cell elongation, mediate phototropism and gravitropism, and maintain apical dominance in plants.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Biology - Plant Growth and Development

qEn: Which biosphere reserve is located in the state of Meghalaya?
qHi: कौन सा बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व मेघालय राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Nokrek Biosphere Reserve is located in the West Garo Hills district of Meghalaya.
sourceHint: NCERT Geography / Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

qEn: Which battle, fought in 1757, marked the beginning of British political supremacy in India?
qHi: 1757 में लड़ी गई किस लड़ाई ने भारत में ब्रिटिश राजनीतिक वर्चस्व की शुरुआत को चिह्नित किया?
explainEn: The Battle of Plassey in 1757 established British East India Company rule in Bengal.

qEn: During the reign of which Gupta ruler was the Chinese pilgrim Faxian (Fa-Hien) visiting India?
qHi: किस गुप्त शासक के शासनकाल के दौरान चीनी यात्री फाह्यान ने भारत का दौरा किया था?
explainEn: Faxian visited India during the reign of Chandragupta II, also known as Vikramaditya, in the early 5th century CE.

qEn: What is the primary function of ribosomes within a living cell?
qHi: एक जीवित कोशिका के भीतर राइबोसोम का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
explainEn: Ribosomes are cellular structures responsible for translating messenger RNA into proteins, earning them the title of the protein factories of the cell.

qEn: Who founded the Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873 to work for the upliftment of the oppressed classes?
qHi: पीड़ित वर्गों के उत्थान के लिए 1873 में सत्यशोधक समाज की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Jyotirao Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj (Society of Seekers of Truth) on September 24, 1873, in Maharashtra.

qEn: Which Vijayanagar ruler is credited with founding the city of Nagalapuram in honor of his mother?
qHi: किस विजयनगर शासक को अपनी माँ के सम्मान में नागलापुरम शहर की स्थापना का श्रेय दिया जाता है?
explainEn: Krishnadevaraya founded the suburban township of Nagalapuram in memory of his mother Nagalaidevi.

qEn: In which atmospheric layer do most weather phenomena take place?
qHi: अधिकांश मौसमी घटनाएँ वायुमंडल की किस परत में घटित होती हैं?
explainEn: The troposphere is the lowest layer of the atmosphere where almost all weather changes and phenomena occur.

qEn: What is the chemical name of the compound commonly known as washing soda?
qHi: सामान्यतः धावन सोडा (वाशिंग सोडा) के रूप में जाने जाने वाले यौगिक का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
explainEn: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate with the chemical formula Na2CO3.10H2O.

qEn: Which instrument is commonly used to measure atmospheric pressure?
qHi: वायुमंडलीय दबाव को मापने के लिए आमतौर पर किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: A barometer is a scientific instrument used to measure air pressure in a certain environment.

qEn: Which Mughal Emperor had the mausoleum known as Bibi Ka Maqbara built in Aurangabad?
qHi: किस मुगल सम्राट ने औरंगाबाद में बीबी का मकबरा बनवाया था?
explainEn: Bibi Ka Maqbara was built by Azam Shah, son of the Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb, in memory of his mother Dilras Banu Begum.

qEn: Which river originates from the Mahabaleshwar in the Western Ghats?
qHi: पश्चिमी घाट में महाबलेश्वर से कौन सी नदी निकलती है?
explainEn: The Krishna River originates from Mahabaleshwar in the state of Maharashtra and flows into the Bay of Bengal.

qEn: What is the primary mineral ore from which aluminum is extracted?
qHi: वह प्राथमिक खनिज अयस्क कौन सा है जिससे एल्युमिनियम निकाला जाता है?
explainEn: Bauxite is the principal ore of aluminum, containing hydrated aluminum oxides.

qEn: Which dynasty constructed the famous Ellora Caves in Maharashtra?
qHi: महाराष्ट्र में प्रसिद्ध एलोरा गुफाओं का निर्माण किस राजवंश ने करवाया था?
explainEn: The Ellora Caves were built during the rule of the Rashtrakuta dynasty, with Cave 16 (Kailash Temple) being a prominent example.

qEn: What is the primary ore of aluminum?
qHi: एल्युमिनियम का मुख्य अयस्क कौन सा है?
explainEn: Bauxite is the primary ore of aluminum, consisting mainly of hydrated aluminum oxides.

qEn: The famous battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The Battle of Plassey was fought on 23 June 1757, establishing British East India Company rule in Bengal.

qEn: In which Vedic text is the term 'Varna' referred to for the first time?
qHi: किस वैदिक ग्रंथ में 'वर्ण' शब्द का उल्लेख सबसे पहले मिलता है?
explainEn: The term 'Varna' appears for the first time in the Purusha Sukta of the 10th Mandala of the Rigveda.

qEn: Which biogeographic zone in India contains the highest percentage of endemic species of flowering plants?
qHi: भारत के किस जैव-भौगोलिक क्षेत्र में पुष्पीय पौधों की स्थानिक प्रजातियों का प्रतिशत सबसे अधिक है?
explainEn: The Western Ghats are globally recognized as a biodiversity hotspot with exceptionally high endemism, particularly in flowering plants.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Biology - Biodiversity and Conservation

qEn: What is the primary objective of the 'Wassenaar Arrangement', of which India is a member?
qHi: वासनेय व्यवस्था (Wassenaar Arrangement), जिसका भारत एक सदस्य है, का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
optsEn: Export controls for conventional arms and dual-use goods
Prevention of proliferation of chemical weapons
optsHi: पारंपरिक हथियारों और दोहरे उपयोग वाली वस्तुओं के लिए निर्यात नियंत्रण
रासायनिक हथियारों के प्रसार की रोकथाम
explainEn: The Wassenaar Arrangement is a multilateral export control regime aimed at contributing to regional and international security by promoting transparency in conventional arms and dual-use goods.

qEn: Which committee recommended the establishment of a Central Vigilance Commission in India?
qHi: भारत में केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयोग (CVC) की स्थापना की सिफारिश किस समिति ने की थी?
explainEn: The Committee on Prevention of Corruption, chaired by K. Santhanam, recommended the setting up of the Central Vigilance Commission.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth / CVC Official Portal

qEn: Which of the following soils is best suited for the cultivation of cotton due to its high moisture-retention capacity?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी मिट्टी अपनी उच्च नमी धारण क्षमता के कारण कपास की खेती के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त है?
explainEn: Black soils, also known as Regur soils, are rich in clay and possess high moisture retention capacity, making them ideal for cotton cultivation.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional dance festival celebrated in which state of India?
qHi: बिहू भारत के किस राज्य में मनाया जाने वाला पारंपरिक नृत्य उत्सव है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural festivals of Assam namely Rongali Bihu, Kongali Bihu, and Bhogali Bihu.

qEn: Which organ in the human body produces bile juice?
qHi: मानव शरीर में कौन सा अंग पित्त रस का उत्पादन करता है?
explainEn: The liver is the largest gland in the human body and secretes bile, which is stored in the gall bladder.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution defines 'Money Bills' and restricts the power of the Rajya Sabha regarding them?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'धन विधेयकों' को परिभाषित करता है और उनके संबंध में राज्य सभा की शक्ति को प्रतिबंधित करता है?
explainEn: Article 110 of the Indian Constitution specifically deals with the definition of Money Bills.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the officer responsible for maintaining land revenue records and land grants was known by which term?
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, भू-राजस्व रिकॉर्ड और भूमि अनुदान बनाए रखने के लिए जिम्मेदार अधिकारी को किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
explainEn: In Gupta epigraphs, the Pustapala is identified as the record-keeper who maintained documents related to land transactions.

qEn: Which biogeographic zone of India is characterized by the presence of the Nilgiri Tahr and an assembly of endemic Western Ghats flora and fauna?
qHi: भारत के किस जैव-भौगोलिक क्षेत्र की विशेषता नीलगिरी तहर और स्थानिक पश्चिमी घाट के वनस्पतियों और जीवों की उपस्थिति है?
explainEn: The Western Ghats is recognized as a distinct biogeographic zone known for high endemism, including the Nilgiri Tahr.
sourceHint: Wildlife Institute of India Biogeographic Classification

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which organization acts as the statutory manager of foreign exchange reserves?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, कौन सा संगठन विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार के विधिक प्रबंधक के रूप में कार्य करता है?
explainEn: Under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, the RBI is entrusted with the management of India's foreign exchange reserves.

qEn: Which wind system is primarily responsible for the winter rainfall experienced in the northwestern part of the Indian subcontinent?
qHi: भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप के उत्तर-पश्चिमी भाग में होने वाली शीतकालीन वर्षा के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी पवन प्रणाली जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Western Disturbances, which are temperate storms originating in the Mediterranean region, bring winter rains to northwestern India.

qEn: Who among the following was the founder of the Satyashodhak Samaj established in 1873 in Maharashtra?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन महाराष्ट्र में 1873 में स्थापित सत्यशोधक समाज के संस्थापक थे?
explainEn: Jyotirao Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj on September 24, 1873, to advocate for the rights of depressed classes.

qEn: Which Indian state has the statutory authority to declare a 'Scheduled Area' under the Fifth Schedule of the Constitution?
qHi: संविधान की पांचवीं अनुसूची के तहत किसी क्षेत्र को 'अनुसूचित क्षेत्र' घोषित करने का वैधानिक अधिकार किसके पास है?
explainEn: Paragraph 6(1) of the Fifth Schedule explicitly empowers the President of India to declare any area to be a Scheduled Area.

qEn: In physics and astronomy, what is the Chandrasekhar limit primarily a measure of?
qHi: भौतिकी और खगोल विज्ञान में, चंद्रशेखर सीमा मुख्य रूप से किसका माप है?
optsEn: Maximum mass of a stable white dwarf star
Maximum speed limit of a pulsar
Radius of a supermassive black hole
optsHi: एक स्थिर श्वेत वामन तारे का अधिकतम द्रव्यमान
एक अतिविशाल ब्लैक होल की त्रिज्या
तारकीय नर्सरी के बीच की दूरी
explainEn: The Chandrasekhar limit is approximately 1.44 times the mass of the Sun and is the maximum mass permissible for a stable white dwarf star.

qEn: In which year was the Battle of Plassey fought?
qHi: प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The Battle of Plassey was fought on 23 June 1757, establishing British East India Company rule in Bengal.

qEn: What is the primary ore of aluminium?
qHi: एल्युमिनियम का मुख्य अयस्क कौन सा है?
explainEn: Bauxite is the principal ore of aluminium, consisting mainly of hydrated aluminium oxides.

qEn: Which hill range separates the Narmada and Tapti river valleys?
qHi: कौन सी पहाड़ी श्रृंखला नर्मदा और ताप्ती नदी घाटियों को अलग करती है?
explainEn: The Satpura Range lies between the Narmada river valley to the north and the Tapti river valley to the south.

qEn: Who wrote the ancient Indian treatise on statecraft and economy, 'Arthashastra'?
qHi: प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ 'अर्थशास्त्र' (राजनीति और अर्थव्यवस्था पर) किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Arthashastra was authored by Kautilya (also known as Chanakya or Vishnugupta), who was the chief minister of Chandragupta Maurya.

qEn: Which physiological process is primarily responsible for the ascent of sap in tall trees against gravity?
qHi: लंबे पेड़ों में गुरुत्वाकर्षण के विरुद्ध रस (sap) के ऊपर चढ़ने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी शारीरिक प्रक्रिया उत्तरदायी है?
optsHi: फ्लोएम चालनी नलिकाओं के माध्यम से परासरण
explainEn: The cohesion-tension-transpiration pull model, combined with root pressure, explains the ascent of sap in tall trees.

qEn: Which Indian state has the maximum length of National Highways according to the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways data?
qHi: सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय के आंकड़ों के अनुसार किस भारतीय राज्य में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्गों की लंबाई सबसे अधिक है?
explainEn: Maharashtra holds the position for having the maximum length of National Highways among all Indian states as per official transport statistics.
sourceHint: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways Annual Report

qEn: What is the primary mineral composition of the Earth's mantle layer?
qHi: पृथ्वी की मेंटल परत की प्राथमिक खनिज संरचना क्या है?
explainEn: The Earth's mantle is predominantly composed of silicate rocks rich in magnesium and iron, often referred to as peridotite.

qEn: Which of the following archaeological sites provides evidence of a unique stadium structure within the Indus Valley Civilization?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा पुरातात्विक स्थल सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के भीतर एक अद्वितीय स्टेडियम संरचना का प्रमाण देता है?
explainEn: Dholavira features a large stadia-like ground, unique among Indus Valley sites.

qEn: What is the standard unit of measuring frequency?
qHi: आवर्ती मापने की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of frequency is the hertz, defined as one cycle per second.

qEn: Which plateau is known as the mineral heartland of India?
qHi: किस पठार को भारत का खनिज हृदय स्थल कहा जाता है?
explainEn: The Chota Nagpur Plateau is rich in vast reserves of coal, iron ore, mica, and other minerals, earning it the title of the mineral heartland of India.

qEn: Which Amendment of the Constitution added the Fundamental Duties to the Indian Constitution?
qHi: संविधान के किस संशोधन द्वारा भारतीय संविधान में मौलिक कर्तव्यों को जोड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976 added Article 51A, incorporating Fundamental Duties into the Constitution based on the Swaran Singh Committee recommendations.

qEn: Which Gupta ruler is depicted playing the Veena on his gold coins?
qHi: किस गुप्त शासक को उसके सोने के सिक्कों पर वीणा बजाते हुए दर्शाया गया है?
explainEn: Samudragupta's patronage of arts is evident from his gold coins that depict him playing the Veena (lyre).

qEn: What is the primary function of heavy water in a nuclear reactor?
qHi: परमाणु रिएक्टर में भारी पानी का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: To slow down the speed of neutrons
optsHi: न्यूट्रॉन की गति को धीमा करना
परमाणु ईंधन के रूप में कार्य करना
explainEn: Heavy water (deuterium oxide) is used in nuclear reactors as a moderator to slow down fast neutrons, increasing the probability of fission.

qEn: Which vitamin is synthesized in the human body by exposure to sunlight?
qHi: सूरज की रोशनी के संपर्क में आने से मानव शरीर में कौन सा विटामिन बनता है?
explainEn: Vitamin D is produced in the skin when exposed to ultraviolet B (UVB) rays from sunlight.

qEn: What is the primary commercial crop grown in the black soil region of India?
qHi: भारत के काली मिट्टी वाले क्षेत्र में उगाई जाने वाली प्रमुख व्यावसायिक फसल कौन सी है?
explainEn: Black soil, also known as Regur soil, is ideal for growing cotton due to its high moisture retention capacity.

qEn: Which organization is responsible for calculating the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in India?
qHi: भारत में सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) की गणना के लिए कौन सा संगठन जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: The National Statistical Office (NSO), under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, is responsible for macroeconomic data collection and GDP calculation.
sourceHint: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

qEn: Which element has the highest electrical conductivity among all known metals?
qHi: सभी ज्ञात धातुओं में से किस तत्व की विद्युत चालकता सबसे अधिक होती है?
explainEn: Silver has the highest electrical conductivity and thermal conductivity of any known metal.

qEn: At which session of the Indian National Congress was the historic 'Purna Swaraj' resolution adopted?
qHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के किस अधिवेशन में ऐतिहासिक 'पूर्ण स्वराज' प्रस्ताव पारित किया गया था?
explainEn: The Purna Swaraj declaration was promulgated at the Lahore session of the INC held in December 1929, presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru.

qEn: Which gas constitutes the maximum percentage of Earth's atmosphere?
qHi: कौन सी गैस पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल का अधिकतम प्रतिशत बनाती है?
explainEn: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere by volume.

qEn: What is the chemical name of washing soda?
qHi: धोने के सोडा (वाशिंग सोडा) का रासायनिक नाम क्या है?
explainEn: Washing soda is chemically known as sodium carbonate decahydrate with the formula Na2CO3·10H2O.

qEn: Which Indian classical dance form originated in the state of Kerala and is traditionally performed by males?
qHi: कौन सा भारतीय शास्त्रीय नृत्य रूप केरल राज्य में उत्पन्न हुआ और पारंपरिक रूप से पुरुषों द्वारा किया जाता है?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance originating from Kerala, distinguished by its elaborate makeup and costumes, traditionally performed by males.
sourceHint: Centre for Cultural Resources and Training (CCRT)

qEn: The 'Dada Saheb Phalke Award' is given annually for lifetime contribution to which field in India?
qHi: भारत में 'दादा साहब फाल्ke पुरस्कार' किस क्षेत्र में आजीवन योगदान के लिए प्रतिवर्ष दिया जाता है?
explainEn: The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is India's highest award in cinema, presented annually by the Directorate of Film Festivals.
sourceHint: Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Government of India

qEn: During the reign of which Delhi Sultanate ruler was the department of agriculture known as 'Diwan-i-Kohi' created?
qHi: दिल्ली सल्तनत के किस शासक के शासनकाल में कृषि विभाग जिसे 'दीवान-ए-कोही' के नाम से जाना जाता था, की स्थापना की गई थी?
explainEn: Muhammad bin Tughlaq created a separate department of agriculture called Diwan-i-Kohi with the objective of increasing land cultivation by giving direct financial aid to peasants.

qEn: Which fundamental right cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency declared under Article 352 of the Indian Constitution?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत घोषित राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान भी कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार निलंबित नहीं किया जा सकता है?
explainEn: By the 44th Amendment Act of 1978, the right to protection in respect of conviction for offenses (Article 20) and the right to life and personal liberty (Article 21) cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth / Constitution of India

qEn: What is the primary chemical compound responsible for the pungent smell of bruised garlic?
qHi: कुचले हुए लहसुन की तीखी गंध के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा रासायनिक यौगिक जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Allicin is an organosulfur compound obtained from garlic. When garlic is chopped or crushed, the enzyme alliinase converts alliin into allicin, which is responsible for the characteristic aroma.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which institution is legally mandated to set the target for the Consumer Price Index inflation?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक मुद्रास्फीति के लक्ष्य को निर्धारित करने के लिए कानूनी रूप से कौन सी संस्था अधिकृत है?
optsEn: Central Government in consultation with the Reserve Bank of India
Monetary Policy Committee independently without government input
optsHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक के परामर्श से केंद्र सरकार
सरकारी इनपुट के बिना स्वतंत्र रूप से मौद्रिक नीति समिति
explainEn: Under Section 45ZA of the RBI Act, the Central Government, in consultation with the RBI, determines the inflation target in terms of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) once every five years.

qEn: Which Gupta ruler assumed the titles of 'Vikramaditya' and 'Kramaditya' as evidenced by their gold coinage?
qHi: अपने स्वर्ण सिक्कों के साक्ष्य के अनुसार किस गुप्त शासक ने 'विक्रमादित्य' और 'क्रमादित्य' की उपाधियाँ धारण की थीं?
explainEn: Kumaragupta I issued gold coins bearing titles such as 'Mahendraditya', 'Shri Mahendra', and 'Ashvamedha-Mahendra', while his successor Skandagupta used 'Vikramaditya' and 'Kramaditya'. Wait, Kumaragupta I is primarily known for 'Mahendraditya'. Let's verify Skandagupta: Skandagupta used 'Vikramaditya' and 'Kramaditya'. Therefore, Skandagupta is the correct answer.

qEn: Which vitamin is primarily produced in the human body with the help of sunlight?
qHi: सूर्य के प्रकाश की सहायता से मानव शरीर में मुख्य रूप से कौन सा विटामिन बनता है?
explainEn: Skin cells produce Vitamin D when exposed to ultraviolet B rays from the sun.

qEn: Which state is the origin of the classical dance form Kathakali?
qHi: शास्त्रीय नृत्य शैली कथकली का उद्गम किस राज्य में हुआ है?
explainEn: Kathakali is a traditional classical dance form originating from the southern state of Kerala.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: Who founded the Maurya Empire after defeating Dhanananda?
qHi: धनानंद को हराने के बाद मौर्य साम्राज्य की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire with the help of Chanakya after overthrowing the Nanda dynasty ruler Dhanananda.

qEn: Which Five-Year Plan in India placed primary emphasis on the 'Garibi Hatao' (Removal of Poverty) slogan?
qHi: भारत में किस पंचवर्षीय योजना में 'गरीबी हटाو' नारे पर मुख्य जोर दिया गया था?
explainEn: The Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974–1979) emphasized poverty alleviation and employment with the slogan 'Garibi Hatao'.

qEn: During the reign of which Delhi Sultan was the office of 'Diwan-i-Kuhai', the department of agriculture, created?
qHi: किस दिल्ली सल्तनत के शासक के शासनकाल में कृषि विभाग 'दीवान-ए-कोही' की स्थापना की गई थी?
explainEn: Muhammad bin Tughlaq created a separate department of agriculture known as 'Diwan-i-Kuhai' to bring uncultivated land under cultivation by giving direct financial support to peasants.

qEn: Which biochemical pathway is common to both aerobic and anaerobic respiration in living organisms?
qHi: जीवित जीवों में वायवीय और अवायवीय दोनों प्रकार के श्वसन के लिए कौन सा जैव रासायनिक मार्ग सामान्य है?
explainEn: Glycolysis is the first stage of cellular respiration that takes place in the cytoplasm and is common to both aerobic and anaerobic respiration, converting glucose into pyruvate.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which institution is legally mandated to manage the liquidity adjustment facility (LAF)?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, किस संस्थान को तरलता समायोजन सुविधा (LAF) के प्रबंधन के लिए कानूनी रूप से अधिकृत किया गया है?
optsEn: Securities and Exchange Board of India
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) uses the Liquidity Adjustment Facility as its primary operating tool of monetary policy to control short-term money market interest rates and liquidity.

qEn: Which archaeological site associated with the Harappan Civilization is located in the state of Gujarat and features a unique system of water reservoirs and a compartmentalized city plan?
qHi: हड़प्पा सभ्यता से संबंधित कौन सा पुरातात्विक स्थल गुजरात राज्य में स्थित है और इसमें जल जलाशयों की एक अनूठी प्रणाली और एक खंडित शहर योजना है?
explainEn: Dholavira, located in Gujarat on Khadir Beyt island, is well known for its unique water management system consisting of channels and reservoirs, as well as being divided into three parts.

qEn: Which of the following mountain ranges is the oldest fold mountain system in India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी पर्वत श्रृंखला भारत की सबसे पुरानी वलित पर्वत प्रणाली है?
explainEn: The Aravalli Range is the oldest fold mountain range in India, running across Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana, and Delhi.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - India: Physical Environment

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which organization is legally mandated to regulate and manage the foreign exchange reserves of the country?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, किस संगठन को देश के विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार को विनियमित और प्रबंधित करने का कानूनी अधिकार प्राप्त है?
optsEn: Securities and Exchange Board of India
explainEn: Under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, the RBI is entrusted with the custody and management of India's foreign exchange reserves.
sourceHint: RBI Official Website and NCERT Economics

qEn: The historic Poona Pact of 1932 was signed between Mahatma Gandhi and whom among the following leaders?
qHi: वर्ष 1932 के ऐतिहासिक पूना पैक्ट पर महात्मा गांधी और निम्नलिखित में से किस नेता के बीच हस्ताक्षर किए गए थे?
explainEn: The Poona Pact was signed on September 24, 1932, at Yerwada Central Jail in Pune by B. R. Ambedkar for the depressed classes and Mahatma Gandhi.

qEn: Which biochemical pathway takes place in the mitochondrial matrix of eukaryotic cells and results in the complete oxidation of acetyl-CoA into carbon dioxide and water?
qHi: यूकेरियोटिक कोशिकाओं के माइटोकॉन्ड्रियल मैट्रिक्स में कौन सा जैव रासायनिक मार्ग होता है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप एसिटिल-कोए का कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड और पानी में पूर्ण ऑक्सीकरण होता है?
explainEn: The citric acid cycle (also known as the Krebs cycle) takes place in the mitochondrial matrix and oxidizes acetyl-CoA.

qEn: Under Article 76 of the Constitution of India, who is empowered to appoint the Attorney General for India?
qHi: भारत के संविधान के अनुच्छेद 76 के तहत, भारत के महान्यायवादी (Attorney General) को नियुक्त करने का अधिकार किसे प्राप्त है?
explainEn: Article 76(1) states that the President shall appoint a person who is qualified to be appointed a Judge of the Supreme Court to be Attorney-General for India.

qEn: Which Harappan site is uniquely characterized by the presence of a dockyard, pointing to extensive maritime trade activities?
qHi: किस हड़प्पा स्थल की विशेषता एक गोदीवाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) की उपस्थिति है, जो व्यापक समुद्री व्यापार गतिविधियों को इंगित करता है?
explainEn: Lothal, located in Gujarat, features a massive tidal dockyard, which archaeologists associate with maritime trade with the Persian Gulf.

qEn: Which hill range acts as a watershed between the Narmada and Tapti rivers?
qHi: कौन सी पहाड़ी श्रृंखला नर्मदा और ताप्ती नदियों के बीच जल विभाधक का कार्य करती है?
explainEn: The Satpura Range lies between the Narmada valley in the north and the Tapti valley in the south, serving as a major watershed.

qEn: Which of the following rock systems in India is the primary source of metallic minerals like iron ore and manganese?
qHi: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी चट्टान प्रणाली लौह अयस्क और मैंगनीज जैसे धातु खनिजों का प्राथमिक स्रोत है?
explainEn: The Dharwar rock system is economically the most important rock system in India because it possesses valuable metallic minerals like iron ore, manganese, copper, and gold.

qEn: Which dance form is classical to the state of Kerala?
qHi: कौन सा नृत्य रूप केरल राज्य का शास्त्रीय नृत्य है?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance that originated in Kerala.

qEn: The Rourkela Steel Plant was established in collaboration with which country?
qHi: राउरकेला इस्पात संयंत्र की स्थापना किस देश के सहयोग से की गई थी?
explainEn: Rourkela Steel Plant in Odisha was set up with the help of a West German enterprise during the Second Five-Year Plan.

qEn: Who wrote the ancient Indian treatise 'Ashtadhyayi' on Sanskrit grammar?
qHi: संस्कृत व्याकरण पर प्राचीन भारतीय ग्रंथ 'अष्टाध्यायी' किसने लिखा था?
explainEn: Panini was a Sanskrit philologist and grammarian who gave a comprehensive and scientific theory of phonetics and grammar in the Ashtadhyayi.

qEn: Which battle marked the formal establishment of the Mughal Empire in India?
qHi: किस युद्ध ने भारत में मुगल साम्राज्य की औपचारिक स्थापना को चिह्नित किया?
explainEn: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in the First Battle of Panipat in 1526, establishing the Mughal Empire.

qEn: What is the primary function of the Reserve Bank of India acting as a 'Lender of Last Resort'?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक के 'अंतिम ऋणदाता' (Lender of Last Resort) के रूप में कार्य करने का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
optsEn: Providing loans to the agricultural sector directly
Providing emergency financial assistance to commercial banks facing liquidity crises
Issuing currency notes to the public
optsHi: कृषि क्षेत्र को सीधे ऋण प्रदान करना
तरलता संकट का सामना कर रहे वाणिज्यिक बैंकों को आपातकालीन वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना
विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार को विनियमित करना
जनता को करेंसी नोट जारी करना
explainEn: As the lender of last resort, RBI provides emergency credit to commercial banks that are solvent but facing short-term liquidity stress.

qEn: Under which Mughal emperor did the painting of the Jahangiri Nama reach its peak of naturalistic representation?
qHi: किस मुगल सम्राट के शासनकाल में जहांगीर नामा की चित्रकला प्राकृतिक चित्रण के अपने शिखर पर पहुँची?
explainEn: Mughal painting reached its zenith in terms of portraiture, flora, and fauna depiction during the reign of Emperor Jahangir.

qEn: In the context of ancient Indian history, the term 'Udranga' refers to what type of tax?
qHi: प्राचीन भारतीय इतिहास के संदर्भ में, 'उद्रंग' शब्द किस प्रकार के कर को संदर्भित करता है?
optsEn: Toll tax collected on trade routes
optsHi: सिंचाई पर लगाया जाने वाला जल कर
व्यापार मार्गों पर एकत्र किया जाने वाला टोल कर
explainEn: In the Gupta and post-Gupta periods, Udranga was a major land tax, often distinguished from Uparakara (an extra tax).

qEn: The 'Bhagavati Sutra', an important canonical text that mentions the sixteen Mahajanapadas, belongs to which religious tradition?
qHi: सोलह महाजनपदों का उल्लेख करने वाला एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रामाणिक ग्रंथ 'भगवती सूत्र' किस धार्मिक परंपरा से संबंधित है?
explainEn: The Bhagavati Sutra is a Jain Agama text that provides detailed accounts of the Mahajanapadas and the life of Mahavira.

qEn: Which specific microorganism is primarily responsible for the nitrogen fixation process in the root nodules of leguminous plants?
qHi: फलीदार पौधों (लेग्यूमिनस) की जड़ों की गांठों में नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण प्रक्रिया के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा विशिष्ट सूक्ष्म जीव जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Rhizobium bacteria form a symbiotic relationship with leguminous plants, living in their root nodules and fixing atmospheric nitrogen into ammonia.

qEn: The 'Purbin' style, a major sub-genre of Indian classical music associated with the rendering of Thumri, originated primarily in which cultural region?
qHi: ठुमरी की प्रस्तुति से जुड़ी भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीत की एक प्रमुख उप-शैली 'पूर्बी' शैली, मुख्य रूप से किस सांस्कृतिक क्षेत्र में उत्पन्न हुई थी?
explainEn: The Purbin ang (style) of Thumri developed primarily in the Awadh region, specifically around Lucknow and Varanasi, focusing on the lyrics and emotional expression.
sourceHint: Centre for Cultural Resources and Training (CCRT) India

qEn: In economic terms, what does the term 'Narrow Money' (M1) in India comprise?
qHi: आर्थिक शब्दों में, भारत में 'संकुचित मुद्रा' (M1) शब्द में क्या शामिल है?
optsEn: Currency with the public plus demand deposits with banks
Currency with the public plus total time deposits with banks
Demand deposits plus all post office savings bank deposits
Total currency in circulation plus RBI reserves
optsHi: जनता के पास मुद्रा और बैंकों के पास मांग जमा
जनता के पास मुद्रा और बैंकों के पास कुल सावधि जमा
मांग जमा और सभी डाकघर बचत बैंक जमा
संचलन में कुल मुद्रा और आरबीआई भंडार
explainEn: According to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) definitions, M1 (Narrow Money) includes currency with the public and demand deposits with the banking system (Current accounts and Savings accounts).

qEn: Kanha National Park is primarily famous for the conservation of which animal?
qHi: कान्हा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान मुख्य रूप से किस जानवर के संरक्षण के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Kanha National Park, located in Madhya Pradesh, is renowned for its substantial tiger population.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

qEn: Which constitutional amendment Act in India reduced the voting age from 21 years to 18 years?
qHi: भारत में किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा मतदान की आयु 21 वर्ष से घटाकर 18 वर्ष कर दी गई थी?
explainEn: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act of 1988 lowered the voting age of elections to the Lok Sabha and Legislative Assemblies of States from 21 years to 18 years.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth, Chapter on Elections

qEn: Which soil type, also known as regur soil, is best suited for the cultivation of cotton?
qHi: किस प्रकार की मिट्टी को रेगुर मिट्टी भी कहा जाता है और यह कपास की खेती के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त है?
