explainEn: Black soil is also known as regur soil. It is ideal for growing cotton and is also referred to as black cotton soil.

qEn: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) established under the Reserve Bank of India Act?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) की स्थापना किस वर्ष भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक अधिनियम के तहत की गई थी?
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India was established on April 1, 1935, in accordance with the provisions of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
sourceHint: RBI Official Website / Indian Economy by Ramesh Singh

qEn: Which chemical element has the chemical symbol 'Au' derived from its Latin name aurum?
qHi: किस रासायनिक तत्व का रासायनिक प्रतीक 'Au' है जो उसके लैटिन नाम ऑurum से लिया गया है?
explainEn: Gold has the chemical symbol Au, which comes from the Latin word aurum, meaning 'shining dawn'.

qEn: During the British colonial rule in India, the Vernacular Press Act was enacted in which year?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन के दौरान, वर्नाकुलर प्रेस अधिनियम किस वर्ष पारित किया गया था?
explainEn: The Vernacular Press Act was enacted in 1878 by Lord Lytton to curtail the freedom of the Indian-language press.

qEn: Which cell organelle is known as the 'suicide bag' of the cell due to the presence of hydrolytic enzymes?
qHi: हाइड्रॉलाइटिक एंजाइमों की उपस्थिति के कारण किस कोशिका अंगक को कोशिका की 'आत्महत्या की थैली' कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Lysosomes contain digestive enzymes capable of breaking down various cellular components, earning them the term 'suicide bags'.

qEn: Which historical monument is located in Agra?
qHi: कौन सा ऐतिहासिक स्मारक आगरा में स्थित है?
explainEn: The Taj Mahal is a mausoleum located on the right bank of the Yamuna river in Agra.

qEn: What is the upper house of the Parliament of India called?
qHi: भारत की संसद के उच्च सदन को क्या कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the bicameral Parliament of India.

qEn: Which plateau lies between the Aravali range and the Vindhya range?
qHi: अरावली श्रेणी और विंध्य श्रेणी के बीच कौन सा पठार स्थित है?
explainEn: The Malwa plateau is bounded by the Central Highlands in the west, with the Aravali range in the west-northwest and the Vindhya range in the south.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 9 Geography, Contemporary India I

qEn: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution can the Parliament legislate on a subject in the State List in the national interest?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत संसद राष्ट्रीय हित में राज्य सूची के किसी विषय पर कानून बना सकती है?
explainEn: Article 249 empowers the Parliament to legislate with respect to a matter enumerated in the State List if the Rajya Sabha has passed a resolution supported by not less than two-thirds of the members present and voting.

qEn: Which site of the Indus Valley Civilization is famous for its sophisticated water management system involving a series of reservoirs and storm water drains?
qHi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का कौन सा स्थल जलाशयों और वर्षा जल नालियों की श्रृंखला से जुड़ी अपनी परिष्कृत जल प्रबंधन प्रणाली के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Dholavira, located in Gujarat, is renowned for its unique water management system, featuring massive stone-cut reservoirs and elaborate channel networks.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part I

qEn: Which oceanic trench is formed by the subduction of the Indo-Australian plate under the Eurasian plate?
qHi: यूरेशियन प्लेट के नीचे इंडो-ऑस्ट्रेलियन प्लेट के सबडक्शन से कौन सी महासागरीय खड्ड बनती है?
explainEn: The Sunda Trench, also known as the Java Trench, is located in the Indian Ocean and is formed by the subduction of the Indo-Australian plate beneath the Eurasian plate.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography, Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: Who among the following revolutionaries was the founder of the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) in 1928?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा क्रांतिकारी 1928 में हिंदुस्तान सोशलिसटिक रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन (HSRA) का संस्थापक था?
explainEn: Hindustan Republican Association was renamed Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) in September 1928 at Feroz Shah Kotla in Delhi, under the leadership of Chandrashekhar Azad.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History, Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: Which gas constitutes the maximum percentage of the Earth atmosphere?
qHi: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में किस गैस का प्रतिशत सबसे अधिक है?
explainEn: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere.

qEn: In which biogeographic zone of India is the Andaman and Nicobar Islands categorized?
qHi: भारत के किस जैव-भौगोलिक क्षेत्र में अंडमान और निकोबार द्वीप समूह को वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
explainEn: Wildlife Institute of India classifies the biogeographic zones into 10 categories, of which the Andaman and Nicobar Islands constitute a distinct 'Island' biogeographic zone.
sourceHint: NCERT Geography and Wildlife Institute of India

qEn: Under which article of the Indian Constitution is the Finance Commission constituted every five years by the President?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत राष्ट्रपति द्वारा प्रत्येक पांच वर्ष पर वित्त आयोग का गठन किया जाता है?
explainEn: Article 280 of the Constitution of India provides for the constitution of a Finance Commission by the President every five years or at such earlier time as the President considers necessary.

qEn: Which plant hormone is primarily responsible for cell elongation and phototropism in plants?
qHi: पौधों में कोशिका दीर्घीकरण और प्रकाशानुवर्तन के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा पादप हार्मोन जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Auxins are plant hormones produced at the tip of stems and roots, which promote cell elongation and are responsible for phototropic movements.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 10 Science - Control and Coordination

qEn: During the colonial period in India, the Wood's Despatch of 1854 was related to which of the following?
qHi: भारत में औपनिवेशिक काल के दौरान, 1854 का वुड्स डिस्पैच (Wood's Despatch) निम्नलिखित में से किससे संबंधित था?
explainEn: Charles Wood's Despatch on Education in 1854 outlined the educational policy for British India and is often called the 'Magna Carta of English Education in India'.
sourceHint: Modern Indian History by Bipin Chandra

qEn: Which among the following is the chief ore of Aluminium?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एल्यूमीनियम का मुख्य अयस्क है?
explainEn: Bauxite is the primary ore of aluminium, consisting mainly of hydrated aluminium oxides.

qEn: Which historical monument is known as the National Monument of India?
qHi: किस ऐतिहासिक स्मारक को भारत का राष्ट्रीय स्मारक कहा जाता है?
explainEn: India Gate, located in New Delhi, is officially known as the All India War Memorial and functions as the national monument of India.

qEn: What is the primary mineral constituent of limestone rock?
qHi: चुના पत्थर (लाइमस्टोन) चट्टान का मुख्य खनिज घटक क्या है?
explainEn: Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed primarily of calcium carbonate in the form of the mineral calcite.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography, Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides the President of India with the power to promulgate ordinances during recess of Parliament?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद भारत के राष्ट्रपति को संसद के स्थगन के समय अध्यादेश प्रख्यापित करने की शक्ति प्रदान करता है?
explainEn: Article 123 of the Constitution empowers the President to promulgate ordinances during the recess of Parliament. Article 213 provides similar powers to the Governor.

qEn: During the Gupta period, what was the term 'Vishti' used to denote?
qHi: गुप्त काल के दौरान, 'विष्टि' शब्द का प्रयोग किसे दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता था?
explainEn: Vishti refers to forced labor (corvee) which was a source of income for the state in ancient India, particularly documented during the Gupta period.

qEn: In which Vedic text is the term 'Gotra' mentioned for the first time as a lineage system?
qHi: किस वैदिक ग्रंथ में 'गोत्र' शब्द का पहली बार एक वंशीय व्यवस्था के रूप में उल्लेख किया गया है?
explainEn: The term 'Gotra' appeared for the first time in the Rigveda, originally meaning a cowpen or clan lineage.

qEn: Which river flows through the city of Srinagar?
qHi: श्रीनगर शहर किस नदी के किनारे बसा है?
explainEn: The city of Srinagar is situated on the banks of the Jhelum River.

qEn: Who founded the Maurya Empire by defeating Dhanananda of the Nanda dynasty?
qHi: नंद वंश के धनानंद को पराजित करके मौर्य साम्राज्य की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire with the guidance of Chanakya after overthrowing the Nanda dynasty.

qEn: Which organism is primarily responsible for biological nitrogen fixation in symbiosis with the water fern Azolla?
qHi: जल फर्न एजोला के साथ सहजीवन में जैविक नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा जीव जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Anabaena azollae is a cyanobacterium that lives in symbiotic association with the cavities of the leaves of the aquatic fern Azolla, fixing atmospheric nitrogen.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Biology - Microbes in Human Welfare

qEn: In the context of ancient Indian architecture, what does the term 'Mandapa' signify?
qHi: प्राचीन भारतीय वास्तुकला के संदर्भ में, 'मंडप' शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
optsEn: The pillared hall in front of the sanctum
The curved roof of a Nagara style temple
optsHi: गर्भगृह के सामने का स्तंभयुक्त हॉल
नगर शैली के मंदिर की वक्र छत
explainEn: In Hindu temple architecture, a Mandapa is a pillared hall or pavilion for public ceremonies and rituals, situated immediately before the garbha griha (sanctum sanctorum).
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Fine Arts - An Introduction to Indian Art

qEn: Under the Indian Constitution, the power to abolish or create a Legislative Council in a state is vested in which body?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के तहत, किसी राज्य में विधान परिषद को समाप्त करने या सृजित करने की शक्ति किस निकाय में निहित है?
optsEn: President of India on Governor's advice
optsHi: राज्यपाल की सलाह पर भारत के राष्ट्रपति
explainEn: According to Article 169 of the Constitution, Parliament may by law create or abolish a Legislative Council if the State Legislative Assembly passes a resolution to that effect by a special majority.

qEn: Which tropical cyclone scale is used exclusively to measure wind speed intensity in the North Indian Ocean basin by the India Meteorological Department?
qHi: भारतीय मौसम विज्ञान विभाग द्वारा उत्तर हिंद महासागर बेसिन में हवा की गति की तीव्रता को मापने के लिए विशेष रूप से किस उष्णकटिबंधीय चक्रवात पैमाने का उपयोग किया जाता है?
optsEn: IMD Intensity Scale based on Maximum Sustained Surface Winds
optsHi: अधिकतम निरंतर सतही हवाओं पर आधारित आईएमडी तीव्रता पैमाना
explainEn: IMD classifies tropical cyclones in the North Indian Ocean based on Maximum Sustained Surface Wind (MPSW) speed, using specific categories ranging from Depression to Super Cyclonic Storm.
sourceHint: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Cyclone Warning Guidelines

qEn: Which tropical deciduous tree species is predominant in the moist deciduous forests of India?
qHi: भारत के नम पर्णपाती वनों में मुख्य रूप से कौन सी उष्णकटिबंधीय पर्णपाती वृक्ष प्रजाति पाई जाती है?
explainEn: Teak is one of the most dominant tree species found in the moist deciduous forests of India, along with bamboo, sal, shisham, and sandalwood.

qEn: Which layer of the Earth's interior is primarily composed of nickel and iron (Nife)?
qHi: पृथ्वी के आंतरिक भाग की कौन सी परत मुख्य रूप से निकेल और लोहे (नाइफ) से बनी है?
explainEn: The innermost layer of the Earth is known as the core, also called Nife due to its high concentration of nickel (Ni) and iron (Fe).

qEn: The 'Daspalla' rebellion is associated with which current state of India?
qHi: 'दस्पाल्ला' विद्रोह भारत के किस वर्तमान राज्य से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Daspalla was a princely state located in present-day Odisha, which witnessed popular uprisings against the ruler's policies.

qEn: Who among the following founded the Atmiya Sabha in 1815?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किसने 1815 में आत्मीय सभा की स्थापना की थी?
explainEn: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Atmiya Sabha in 1815 as a philosophical discussion circle in Calcutta.

qEn: Which metal is predominantly used in galvanization of iron to prevent rusting?
qHi: लोहे को जंग लगने से बचाने के लिए गैल्वनीकरण में मुख्य रूप से किस धातु का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: Galvanization is the process of applying a protective zinc coating to steel or iron to prevent rusting.

qEn: Which of the following mountain passes connects Kullu Valley with Lahul and Spiti valleys in Himachal Pradesh?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दर्रा हिमाचल प्रदेश में कुल्लू घाटी को लाहुल और स्पीति घाटियों से जोड़ता है?
explainEn: Rohtang Pass is a high mountain pass on the eastern end of the Pir Panjal Range of the Himalayas, connecting the Kullu Valley with the Lahul and Spiti valleys of Himachal Pradesh.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - India: Physical Environment

qEn: Which element has the highest electrical conductivity at room temperature among metals?
qHi: कमरे के तापमान पर धातुओं में किसकी विद्युत चालकता सबसे अधिक होती है?
explainEn: Silver has the highest electrical conductivity and thermal conductivity of any known metal.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 10 Science - Chapter 3 Metals and Non-metals

qEn: During the reign of which Delhi Sultan was the Iqta system temporarily suspended and revenue collection brought directly under the central control?
qHi: किस दिल्ली सल्तनत के शासक के शासनकाल में इक्ता व्यवस्था को अस्थायी रूप से निलंबित कर दिया गया था और राजस्व संग्रह को सीधे केंद्रीय नियंत्रण में लाया गया था?
explainEn: Alauddin Khalji reorganized the land revenue system, abolished many small iqtas, and brought the collection directly under the central exchequer.

qEn: Which ocean current is a warm current located in the South Atlantic Ocean?
qHi: दक्षिण अटलांटिक महासागर में स्थित कौन सी महासागरीय जलधारा एक गर्म जलधारा है?
explainEn: The Brazil Current is a warm-water current that flows southward along the coast of Brazil in the South Atlantic Ocean.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: In the context of the Indian economy, Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) is maintained by commercial banks in the form of what?
qHi: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के संदर्भ में, वैधानिक तरलता अनुपात (SLR) वाणिज्यिक बैंकों द्वारा किस रूप में बनाए रखा जाता है?
optsEn: Cash reserve with the RBI only
Liquid assets such as cash, gold, or approved securities
Foreign currency reserves with the World Bank
Loans given exclusively to the agricultural sector
optsHi: केवल आरबीआई के पास नकद आरक्षित
नकद, सोना या अनुमोदित प्रतिभूतियों जैसे तरल संपत्ति
विश्व बैंक के साथ विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार
विशेष रूप से कृषि क्षेत्र को दिए गए ऋण
explainEn: SLR requires commercial banks to maintain a prescribed percentage of their net demand and time liabilities in liquid assets like cash, gold, or approved government securities.
sourceHint: RBI official publications and NCERT Economics

qEn: Which hill range lies at the junction of the Eastern Ghats and the Western Ghats?
qHi: पूर्वी घाट और पश्चिमी घाट के मिलन स्थल पर कौन सी पहाड़ी श्रृंखला स्थित है?
explainEn: The Nilgiri Hills form a vital node where the Eastern Ghats and the Western Ghats converge in southern India.

qEn: Which biochemical pathway takes place in the matrix of the mitochondria?
qHi: कौन सी जैव रासायनिक प्रक्रिया माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया के मैट्रिक्स में होती है?
optsEn: Oxidative phosphorylation site in inner membrane
optsHi: आंतरिक झिल्ली में ऑक्सीडेटिव फॉस्फोरिलेशन स्थल
explainEn: The citric acid cycle, also known as the Krebs cycle, occurs in the mitochondrial matrix in eukaryotic cells.

qEn: Which mineral is commercially known as brown coal?
qHi: किस खनिज को व्यावसायिक रूप से भूरा कोयला (ब्राउन कोल) कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Lignite is a low-grade brown coal which is soft and has high moisture content.

qEn: Which Mughal Emperor constructed the Buland Darwaza at Fatehpur Sikri?
qHi: किस मुगल सम्राट ने फतेहपुर सीकरी में बुलंद दरवाजा बनवाया था?
explainEn: Akbar built the Buland Darwaza in 1601 AD at Fatehpur Sikri to commemorate his victory over Gujarat.

qEn: What is the primary function of the ozone layer present in the stratosphere?
qHi: समताप मंडल में मौजूद ओजोन परत का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: Absorbing harmful ultraviolet radiation from the Sun
Generating oxygen for respiration in the lower atmosphere
Regulating the global carbon dioxide cycle
Increasing the surface temperature of the Earth
optsHi: सूर्य से आने वाली हानिकारक पराबैंगनी विकिरण को अवशोषित करना
निचले वायुमंडल में श्वसन के लिए ऑक्सीजन उत्पन्न करना
वैश्विक कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड चक्र को विनियमित करना
पृथ्वी की सतह के तापमान को बढ़ाना
explainEn: The ozone layer in the stratosphere absorbs most of the Sun's ultraviolet (UV) radiation, protecting life on Earth from harmful effects such as skin cancer.

qEn: Which plateaus lies between the Aravali and the Vindhya ranges?
qHi: अरावली और विंध्य श्रेणियों के बीच कौन सा पठार स्थित है?
explainEn: The Malwa Plateau is bounded by the Aravali Range in the west, the Vindhya Range in the south, and the Bundelkhand plateau in the east.

qEn: Under the Constitution of India, the power to commute a death sentence rests with whom?
qHi: भारत के संविधान के तहत, मृत्युदंड को बदलने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
explainEn: Under Article 72 of the Constitution of India, the President has the power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites or remissions of punishment or to commute death sentences.

qEn: Which Vijayanagar ruler wrote the famous Telugu work 'Amuktamalyada'?
qHi: किस विजयनगर शासक ने प्रसिद्ध तेलुगु ग्रंथ 'अमुक्तामाल्यद' की रचना की थी?
explainEn: Krishnadevaraya, the famous emperor of the Tuluva dynasty of the Vijayanagar Empire, authored the Telugu literary work 'Amuktamalyada'.
sourceHint: NCERT History - Themes in Indian History

qEn: Which of the following taxes is levied and collected by the Union, but assigned to the States under the Indian Constitution?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के तहत निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कर केंद्र द्वारा लगाया और एकत्र किया जाता है, लेकिन राज्यों को सौंपा जाता है?
explainEn: Taxes levied and collected by the Union but assigned to the states include taxes on the consignment of goods (Article 269), among others.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth - Centre-State Relations

qEn: Which Mughal emperor shifted the Mughal capital from Agra to Delhi by founding Shahjahanabad?
qHi: किस मुगल सम्राट ने शाहजहानाबाद की स्थापना करके मुगल राजधानी को आगरा से दिल्ली स्थानांतरित किया था?
explainEn: Shah Jahan shifted his capital from Agra to Delhi in 1648 by building the walled city of Shahjahanabad.

qEn: What is the primary chemical compound found in limestone?
qHi: चूना पत्थर (लाइमस्टोन) में पाया जाने वाला प्रमुख रासायनिक यौगिक कौन सा है?
explainEn: Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed largely of the minerals calcite and aragonite, which are different crystal forms of calcium carbonate (CaCO3).

qEn: The headquarters of the International Court of Justice (ICJ) is located in which city?
qHi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय न्यायालय (ICJ) का मुख्यालय किस शहर में स्थित है?
explainEn: The International Court of Justice, the principal judicial organ of the United Nations, is located at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands.

qEn: Which vitamin helps in the clotting of human blood?
qHi: कौन सा विटामिन मानव रक्त के थक्के जमने में मदद करता है?
explainEn: Vitamin K is a group of structurally similar, fat-soluble vitamins that the human body needs for posttranslational modification of proteins required for blood coagulation.

qEn: What is the standard unit of measuring force in the International System of Units (SI)?
qHi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय इकाई प्रणाली (SI) में बल मापने की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of force is the Newton, named after Sir Isaac Newton.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides the procedure for its amendment?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद इसके संशोधन की प्रक्रिया प्रदान کرتا है?
explainEn: Article 368 in Part XX of the Constitution deals with the powers of Parliament to amend the Constitution and its procedure.

qEn: Which gas is primarily responsible for global warming?
qHi: ग्लोबल वार्मिंग के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी गैस जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Carbon dioxide is the primary greenhouse gas contributing significantly to global warming and climate change.

qEn: In which year was the battle of Buxar fought, firmly establishing the British East India Company's political control over Bengal?
qHi: बक्सर का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था, जिसने बंगाल पर ब्रिटिश ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के राजनीतिक नियंत्रण को दृढ़ता से स्थापित किया?
explainEn: The Battle of Buxar was fought on October 22, 1764, between the forces of the British led by Hector Munro and the combined army of Mir Kasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, and Shah Alam II.

qEn: Which among the following soil types covers the largest area in India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मिट्टी का प्रकार भारत में सबसे बड़े क्षेत्र को कवर करता है?
explainEn: Alluvial soil is the most widespread soil in India, covering about 43 percent of the country's total land area, mainly deposited by river systems.

qEn: Which schedule of the Indian Constitution contains provisions regarding the disqualification of members on the grounds of defection?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान की किस अनुसूची में दल-बदल के आधार पर सदस्यों की अयोग्यता से संबंधित प्रावधान हैं?
explainEn: The Tenth Schedule, added by the 52nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1985, contains the anti-defection law provisions.

qEn: In which state is the Ajanta Caves complex located?
qHi: अजंता गुफा परिसर किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: The Ajanta Caves are approximately 30 rock-cut Buddhist cave monuments located in Aurangabad district, Maharashtra.

qEn: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act relates to which of the following?
qHi: 73वां संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम निम्नलिखित में से किससे संबंधित है?
explainEn: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 provides constitutional status to the Panchayati Raj institutions in India by adding Part IX.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth, Chapter on Panchayati Raj

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which organization regulates the Clearing Corporation of India Limited (CCIL)?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, कौन सा संगठन क्लीयरिंग कॉर्पोरेशन ऑफ इंडिया लिमिटेड (CCIL) को विनियमित करता है?
optsEn: Securities and Exchange Board of India
National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
optsHi: राष्ट्रीय कृषि और ग्रामीण विकास बैंक
explainEn: CCIL was set up in 2001 to provide clearing and settlement services for transactions in money, debt, and foreign exchange markets, and it is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India.
sourceHint: RBI Official Website / Indian Economy by Ramesh Singh

qEn: The treaty of Purandhar was signed in the year 1665 between the Mughal Empire, represented by Jai Singh I, and which prominent Maratha leader?
qHi: पुरंदर की संधि वर्ष 1665 में जय सिंह प्रथम द्वारा प्रतिनिधित्व मुगल साम्राज्य और किस प्रमुख मराठा नेता के बीच हस्ताक्षर की गई थी?
explainEn: The Treaty of Purandar was signed on June 11, 1665, by Jai Singh I (commander of the Mughal Empire) and Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj after the siege of Purandar fort.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 7 History / Medieval India by Satish Chandra

qEn: Which bio-geographical zone in India covers the largest geographic area according to the Wildlife Institute of India classification?
qHi: भारतीय वन्यजीव संस्थान के वर्गीकरण के अनुसार भारत में कौन सा जैव-भौगोलिक क्षेत्र सबसे बड़े भौगोलिक क्षेत्र को कवर करता है?
explainEn: The Deccan Peninsula is the largest bio-geographical zone in India, covering about 43 percent of the total landmass, encompassing parts of Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu.
sourceHint: Environment by Shankar IAS Academy / WII Classification

qEn: The term 'Operation Polo' is historically associated with the integration of which princely state into the Indian Union?
qHi: शब्द 'ऑपरेशन पोलो' ऐतिहासिक रूप से किस रियासत के भारतीय संघ में एकीकरण से जुड़ा है?
explainEn: Operation Polo was the code name for the police action in September 1948 by the Government of India against the princely state of Hyderabad, resulting in its annexation.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 Political Science / Indian History

qEn: Which historical monument is located in Agra and built by Shah Jahan?
qHi: आगरा में स्थित कौन सा ऐतिहासिक स्मारक शाहजहाँ द्वारा बनवाया गया था?
explainEn: The Taj Mahal was commissioned by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in Agra.

qEn: Which Five-Year Plan in India was based on the Mahalanobis model?
qHi: भारत की कौन सी पंचवर्षीय योजना महालनोबिस मॉडल पर आधारित थी?
explainEn: The Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961) focused on heavy industrialization and was based on the Mahalanobis economic model.

qEn: During the reign of which Delhi Sultan was the Iqta system temporarily suspended and revenue collection brought under direct imperial control?
qHi: किस दिल्ली सल्तनत के शासक के शासनकाल में इक्ता प्रणाली को थोड़े समय के लिए निलंबित कर दिया गया था और राजस्व संग्रह को सीधे शाही नियंत्रण में लाया गया था?
explainEn: Alauddin Khalji abolished the autonomy of the Iqtadars, reduced their privileges, and brought vast areas of land directly under the crown as Khalisa land.

qEn: Which among the following mountain passes connects the Kullu Valley with the Lahaul and Spiti valleys in Himachal Pradesh?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दर्रा हिमाचल प्रदेश में कुल्लू घाटी को लाहुल और स्पीति घाटियों से जोड़ता है?
explainEn: Rohtang Pass is a high mountain pass on the eastern end of the Pir Panjal Range of the Himalayas, connecting the Kullu Valley with the Lahaul and Spiti valleys of Himachal Pradesh.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which of the following instruments is classified as a direct instrument of monetary control?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से किस उपकरण को मौद्रिक नियंत्रण का प्रत्यक्ष उपकरण माना जाता है?
explainEn: Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) and Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) are direct instruments of monetary policy used by the RBI, whereas Repo Rate, Bank Rate, and OMOs are indirect instruments.
sourceHint: Reserve Bank of India publications and NCERT Economics

qEn: The 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019 introduced reservation in admission and public employment for which category?
qHi: 103वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2019 ने किस वर्ग के लिए प्रवेश और सार्वजनिक रोजगार में आरक्षण की शुरुआत की?
explainEn: The 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act inserted Articles 15(6) and 16(6) to provide up to 10 percent reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) in educational institutions and public employment.
sourceHint: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India

qEn: The classical dance form named Kathakali originates from which Indian state?
qHi: कथकली नामक शास्त्रीय नृत्य रूप किस भारतीय राज्य से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major form of classical Indian dance that originated in Kerala.

qEn: Which soil type, formed by the weathering of basaltic lava rocks, is predominantly found in the Deccan Trap region of India?
qHi: बेसाल्टिक लावा चट्टानों के अपक्षय से बनने वाली कौन सी मिट्टी भारत के दक्कन ट्रैप क्षेत्र में प्रमुख रूप से पाई जाती है?
explainEn: Black soil, also known as Regur soil, is formed from the weathering of basaltic lava rocks in the Deccan plateau and is ideal for growing cotton.

qEn: Which atmospheric layer is characterized by the presence of the ozone layer that absorbs harmful ultraviolet radiation?
qHi: किस वायुमंडलीय परत की विशेषता ओजोन परत की उपस्थिति है जो हानिकारक पराबैंगनी विकिरण को अवशोषित करती है?
explainEn: The stratosphere contains the ozone layer, which absorbs harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation coming from the Sun.

qEn: The joint sitting of both Houses of Parliament in India is summoned by whom?
qHi: भारत में संसद के दोनों सदनों की संयुक्त बैठक किसके द्वारा आहूत की जाती है?
explainEn: Under Article 108 of the Constitution, the President of India summons both Houses to a joint sitting in certain cases of deadlock, while it is presided over by the Speaker of the Lok Sabha.

qEn: Which of the following vitamins is water-soluble and cannot be stored in the human body in significant amounts?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा विटामिन पानी में घुलनशील है और मानव शरीर में पर्याप्त मात्रा में संग्रहित नहीं किया जा सकता है?
explainEn: Vitamin C and the B-complex vitamins are water-soluble and must be regularly supplied through diet, unlike fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K).

qEn: The famous rock-cut Rathas (temples) of Mahabalipuram were built during the reign of which dynasty?
qHi: महाबलीपुरम के प्रसिद्ध चट्टानों को काटकर बनाए गए रथ (मंदिर) किस राजवंश के शासनकाल के दौरान बनाए गए थे?
explainEn: The monolithic rock-cut rathas at Mahabalipuram were constructed during the Pallava dynasty under the patronage of King Mahendravarman I and Narasimhavarman I.

qEn: Which historical monument was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in Agra as a mausoleum for his wife Mumtaz Mahal?
qHi: सम्राट शाहजहाँ द्वारा अपनी पत्नी मुमताज महल के मकबरे के रूप में आगरा में कौन सा ऐतिहासिक स्मारक बनवाया गया था?
explainEn: The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the right bank of the river Yamuna in Agra, built by Shah Jahan.

qEn: Which wind system is primarily responsible for bringing rainfall to the Malabar coast of India during summer?
qHi: ग्रीष्म ऋतु में भारत के मालाबार तट पर वर्षा लाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सी पवन प्रणाली उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: The South-West Monsoon winds strike the western coast of India, including the Malabar coast, bringing heavy rainfall during the summer months.

qEn: Which organism is commonly used as a bio-fertilizer in paddy (rice) fields due to its nitrogen-fixing ability?
qHi: धान के खेतों में नाइट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण की क्षमता के कारण जैव-उर्वरक के रूप में आमतौर पर किस जीव का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: Anabaena, often found in association with the water fern Azolla, fixes atmospheric nitrogen and is widely used as a bio-fertilizer in rice cultivation.

qEn: Who founded the Servants of India Society in 1905?
qHi: 1905 में 'सर्वेंट्स ऑफ़ इंडिया सोसाइटी' की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Gopal Krishna Gokhale founded the Servants of India Society in Pune in 1905 to unite and train Indians of different ethnicities and religions in welfare work.

qEn: The Sunderbans delta is formed by the confluence of which rivers?
qHi: सुंदरबन डेल्टा किन नदियों के संगम से बनता है?
explainEn: The Sunderbans delta is created by the depositional work of the Ganga and Brahmaputra rivers before they empty into the Bay of Bengal.

qEn: What is the primary function of the Reserve Bank of India's reverse repo rate?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक की रिवर्स रेपो रेट का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: To lend short-term funds to commercial banks
To absorb liquidity from the banking system
To provide long-term loans for infrastructure
To fix the foreign exchange reserves directly
optsHi: वाणिज्यिक बैंकों को अल्पकालिक ऋण देना
बैंकिंग प्रणाली से नकदी (तरलता) को अवशोषित करना
बुनियादी ढांचे के लिए दीर्घकालिक ऋण प्रदान करना
विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार को सीधे तय करना
explainEn: The reverse repo rate is the rate at which the central bank of a country borrows money from commercial banks within the country, effectively absorbing liquidity.

qEn: At which session of the Indian National Congress was the 'Purna Swaraj' resolution adopted?
qHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के किस अधिवेशन में 'पूर्ण स्वराज' का प्रस्ताव पारित किया गया था?
explainEn: The 'Purna Swaraj' (complete independence) resolution was adopted at the Lahore session of the INC in December 1929, presided over by Jawaharlal Nehru.

qEn: Which layer of the atmosphere contains the ozone layer that protects the Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation?
qHi: वायुमंडल की किस परत में ओजोन परत पाई जाती है जो पृथ्वी को हानिकारक पराबैंगनी विकिरण से बचाती है?
explainEn: The stratosphere contains a high concentration of ozone, referred to as the ozone layer, which absorbs harmful ultraviolet radiation from the Sun.

qEn: What is the standard unit of measuring frequency in the International System of Units (SI)?
qHi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय इकाई प्रणाली (SI) में आवृत्ति मापने की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The hertz (symbol: Hz) is the derived unit of frequency in the International System of Units, defined as one cycle per second.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the establishment and constitution of the Supreme Court?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद उच्चतम न्यायालय की स्थापना और गठन से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Article 124 of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment and constitution of the Supreme Court of India.

qEn: Which atmospheric layer is responsible for reflecting radio waves back to the Earth?
qHi: कौन सी वायुमंडलीय परत रेडियो तरंगों को वापस पृथ्वी पर परावर्तित करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: The thermosphere contains the ionosphere, which is characterized by the presence of charged particles that reflect radio waves.

qEn: Which vitamin is essential for the normal clotting of human blood?
qHi: मानव रक्त के सामान्य थक्के जमने के लिए कौन सा विटामिन आवश्यक है?
explainEn: Vitamin K plays a major role in blood clotting, bone metabolism, and regulating blood calcium levels.

qEn: In the context of medieval Indian history, what was the primary function of a 'Barid' during the Delhi Sultanate?
qHi: मध्यकालीन भारतीय इतिहास के संदर्भ में, दिल्ली सल्तनत के दौरान 'बरीद' का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
explainEn: Barids were intelligence officers and news reporters appointed by the Sultan to keep him informed about events across the empire.

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers the Parliament to create one or more All India Services common to the Union and the States?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद संसद को संघ और राज्यों के लिए सामान्य एक या All India Services (अखिल भारतीय सेवाएं) सृजित करने का अधिकार देता है?
explainEn: Article 312 of the Constitution authorizes Parliament to create All India Services if the Rajya Sabha passes a resolution supported by two-thirds of members present and voting.

qEn: Which among the following Harappan sites is located in the Kutch district of Gujarat and is known for its unique division of the city into three parts?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा हड़प्पा स्थल गुजरात के कच्छ जिले में स्थित है और शहर के तीन भागों में इसके अनूठे विभाजन के लिए जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Dholavira is unique among major Harappan cities because it was divided into three parts (citadel, middle town, and lower town), unlike most other sites divided into two.

qEn: The phenomenon of 'El Nino', which influences the Indian monsoon, is characterized by:
qHi: भारतीय मानसून को प्रभावित करने वाली 'अल नीनो' घटना की विशेषता क्या है?
optsEn: An abnormal warming of surface waters in the eastern and central Pacific Ocean
A sudden cooling of the Indian Ocean near the western coast of Australia
An increase in pressure over the northern Himalayas during winter
The reversal of trade winds in the Atlantic Ocean
optsHi: पूर्वी और मध्य प्रशांत महासागर में सतही जल का असामान्य रूप से गर्म होना
ऑस्ट्रे्लिया के पश्चिमी तट के पास हिंद महासागर का अचानक ठंडा होना
सर्दियों के दौरान उत्तरी हिमालय पर दबाव में वृद्धि
अटलांटिक महासागर में व्यापारिक हवाओं का उलटना
explainEn: El Nino refers to the warming of sea surface temperatures across the central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean, negatively impacting the Indian southwest monsoon.

qEn: Who established the 'Atmiya Sabha' in Kolkata in the year 1815 to propagate monotheistic ideals of Vedanta and campaign against social evils?
qHi: वेदांत के एकेश्वरवादी आदर्शों का प्रचार करने और सामाजिक बुराइयों के खिलाफ अभियान चलाने के लिए वर्ष 1815 में कोलकाता में 'आत्मीय सभा' की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Atmiya Sabha in 1815 as a philosophical discussion circle in Kolkata, marking the beginning of the reform movement in modern India.
sourceHint: Modern Indian History by Bipin Chandra

qEn: The headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is located in which city?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) का मुख्यालय किस शहर में स्थित है?
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India was established in 1935 and its central office is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

qEn: What is the primary function of heavy water used in nuclear reactors?
qHi: परमाणु रिएक्टरों में प्रयुक्त भारी पानी का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
optsEn: To increase the speed of neutrons
To slow down the speed of neutrons
To cool the reactor core directly without absorption
To act as fuel alongside uranium
optsHi: न्यूट्रांस की गति को धीमा करना
बिना अवशोषण के सीधे रिएक्टर कोर को ठंडा करना
यूरेनियम के साथ ईंधन के रूप में कार्य करना
explainEn: Heavy water (deuterium oxide) is used as a moderator in nuclear reactors to slow down fast-moving neutrons so they can sustain the nuclear fission chain reaction.

qEn: Lakhimpur Kheri and Dudhwa National Park are located in which Indian state?
qHi: खीरी और दुधवा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस भारतीय राज्य में स्थित हैं?
explainEn: Dudhwa National Park is a protected area located in the Lakhimpur Kheri and Bahraich districts of Uttar Pradesh, bordering Nepal.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the officer responsible for maintaining land revenue records was known as:
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, भूमि राजस्व रिकॉर्ड बनाए रखने के लिए जिम्मेदार अधिकारी को क्या कहा जाता था?
explainEn: Pustapala was the designated record keeper in the Gupta administration who maintained land transaction records.

qEn: Which of the following is a Kharif crop in the cropping seasons of India?
qHi: भारत की फसल ऋतुओं में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक खरीफ फसल है?
explainEn: Paddy (rice) is a major Kharif crop sown with the onset of the monsoon season in India.

qEn: The process of transfer of minerals from topsoil to subsoil through rainwater is known as:
qHi: वर्षा के पानी के माध्यम से शीर्ष मृदा से उप-मृदा में खनिजों के स्थानांतरण की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Leaching is the process where water-soluble nutrients and minerals are washed down from the topsoil into lower soil layers.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the officer in charge of the royal treasury and finance was known by which of the following terms?
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, शाही राजकोष और वित्त के प्रभारी अधिकारी को निम्नलिखित में से किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
explainEn: Bhandagaradhikrita was the officer in charge of the royal treasury during the Gupta period.

qEn: The atmospheric layer in which temperature increases sharply with height due to the absorption of ultraviolet radiation by ozone is called:
qHi: वायुमंडल की वह परत जिसमें ओजोन द्वारा पराबैंगनी विकिरण के अवशोषण के कारण ऊंचाई के साथ तापमान तेजी से बढ़ता है, कहलाती है:
explainEn: The stratosphere contains the ozone layer, which absorbs UV rays and causes the temperature to increase with height.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, the term 'Marginal Standing Facility' (MSF) was introduced in which year?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, 'सीमांत स्थायी सुविधा' (MSF) शब्द किस वर्ष शुरू किया गया था?
explainEn: Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) was introduced by the Reserve Bank of India in the Monetary Policy statement for 2011-12.

qEn: Which of the following archaeological sites is famous for yielding the largest Harappan inscription, known as the Dholavira Signboard?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा पुरातात्विक स्थल सबसे बड़े हड़प्पा शिलालेख, जिसे धौलावीरा साइनबोर्ड के रूप में जाना जाता है, के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: The Dholavira sign board is one of the most famous discoveries from the Indus Valley Civilization site of Dholavira in Gujarat.

qEn: The process of transfer of mineral nutrients through the soil profile by water movement is scientifically termed as:
qHi: पानी की गति द्वारा मिट्टी के प्रोफाइल के माध्यम से खनिज पोषक तत्वों के स्थानांतरण की प्रक्रिया को वैज्ञानिक रूप से कहा जाता है:
explainEn: Leaching is the loss of water-soluble plant nutrients from the soil, due to rain and irrigation.

qEn: Under the Government of India Act 1935, the federal court was established in which year?
qHi: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1935 के तहत, संघीय न्यायालय की स्थापना किस वर्ष की गई थी?
explainEn: The Federal Court of India was established in Delhi on 1 October 1937 under the provisions of the Government of India Act 1935.

qEn: Which of the following gases is most abundant in Earth's atmosphere?
qHi: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी गैस सबसे प्रचुर मात्रा में पाई जाती है?
explainEn: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere.

qEn: Which among the following passes connects the Kullu valley with Lahaul and Spiti in Himachal Pradesh?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दर्रा हिमाचल प्रदेश में कुल्लू घाटी को लाहुल और स्पीति से जोड़ता है?
explainEn: The Rohtang Pass is located at the eastern end of the Pir Panjal Range and connects the Kullu valley with the Lahaul and Spiti valleys of Himachal Pradesh.

qEn: What is the primary function of the 'Bile' juice secreted by the liver?
qHi: यकृत द्वारा स्रावित 'पित्त' (Bile) रस का मुख्य कार्य क्या है?
explainEn: Bile does not contain digestive enzymes, but it plays a crucial role in the digestion of fats by breaking down large fat globules into smaller droplets, a process known as emulsification.

qEn: The 'Dronacharya Award' given by the Government of India is associated with which of the following fields?
qHi: भारत सरकार द्वारा दिया जाने वाला 'द्रोणाचार्य पुरस्कार' निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
explainEn: The Dronacharya Award is presented annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports for excellence in sports coaching.
sourceHint: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India

qEn: Which of the following clouds is characterized by its heavy, dense structure and capability of producing thunderstorms and heavy rain?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस बादल की विशेषता उसकी भारी, घनी संरचना और आंधी तथा भारी वर्षा उत्पन्न करने की क्षमता है?
explainEn: Cumulonimbus clouds are heavy and dense clouds associated with thunderstorms, lightning, and heavy precipitation.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography, Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: Which of the following gases is most abundant in the Earth's atmosphere by volume?
qHi: आयतन के अनुसार पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी गैस सबसे प्रचुर मात्रा में है?
explainEn: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of the Earth's atmosphere by volume, followed by Oxygen at roughly 21 percent.

qEn: In which session of the Indian National Congress was the historic 'Purna Swaraj' (Complete Independence) resolution adopted in 1929?
qHi: वर्ष 1929 में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के किस अधिवेशन में ऐतिहासिक 'पूर्ण स्वराज' का प्रस्ताव पारित किया गया था?
explainEn: The Lahore session of the INC in December 1929, under the presidency of Jawaharlal Nehru, passed the Poorna Swaraj resolution.
sourceHint: NCERT Class XII History, Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: Which of the following hill ranges is a part of the Eastern Ghats?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी पहाड़ी श्रृंखला पूर्वी घाट का हिस्सा है?
explainEn: Javadi Hills are located in the Eastern Ghats of Tamil Nadu. Anaimalai, Cardamom, and Nilgiri hills are part of the Western Ghats.
sourceHint: NCERT Class XI Geography, India: Physical Environment

qEn: Which Vijayanagara ruler is the author of the famous Telugu work 'Amuktamalyada'?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध तेलुगु कृति 'अमुक्तमाल्यद' के लेखक विजयनगर के कौन से शासक हैं?
explainEn: Krishnadevaraya, the greatest ruler of the Tuluva dynasty of Vijayanagara, wrote the epic 'Amuktamalyada' in Telugu.
sourceHint: NCERT Class XII History, Themes in Indian History Part II

qEn: Which constitutional amendment introduced the provisions relating to Panchayati Raj Institutions in India?
qHi: किस संविधान संशोधन ने भारत में पंचायती राज संस्थाओं से संबंधित प्रावधानों को पेश किया था?
explainEn: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 added Part IX to the Constitution, providing constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the officer responsible for maintaining land records was known by which term?
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, भूमि अभिलेखों के रख-रखाव के लिए जिम्मेदार अधिकारी को किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
explainEn: Pustapala was the Gupta period official in charge of district records, particularly land transactions and ownership.

qEn: The phenomenon of spring tides occurs when which celestial bodies are aligned?
qHi: वृहत ज्वार (स्प्रिंग टाइड) की घटना तब होती है जब कौन से खगोलीय पिंड संरेखित होते हैं?
optsEn: Sun, Earth, and Moon in a straight line
Sun and Moon at a right angle to the Earth
optsHi: सूर्य, पृथ्वी और चंद्रमा एक सीधी रेखा में
सूर्य और चंद्रमा पृथ्वी के समकोण पर
explainEn: Spring tides occur when the Sun, Earth, and Moon are aligned (syzygy), during new moon and full moon, combining their gravitational pulls.
sourceHint: Certificate Physical and Human Geography by Goh Cheng Leong

qEn: In the context of Indian classical music, what does the term 'Margi' refer to?
qHi: भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीत के संदर्भ में, 'मार्गी' शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
optsEn: Music meant for spiritual liberation and codified in shastras
Folk music originating from tribal regions
Vocal exercises performed before a concert
optsHi: आध्यात्मिक मुक्ति के लिए संगीत और शास्त्रों में संहिताबद्ध
आदिवासी क्षेत्रों से उत्पन्न लोक संगीत
संगीत समारोह से पहले किए जाने वाले मुखर अभ्यास
explainEn: In ancient Indian musicology, Margi sangeet refers to the celestial or classical tradition codified in sacred texts aimed at attaining moksha, distinct from Deshi (regional) music.

qEn: Under the Government of India Act 1935, residuary powers were vested in which authority?
qHi: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1935 के तहत, अवशिष्ट शक्तियां किस प्राधिकारी में निहित थीं?
explainEn: Under the 1935 Act, residuary powers were not assigned to either the federal or provincial legislatures; instead, the Governor-General was empowered to decide which legislature could legislate on them.

qEn: Which specific crop was primarily targeted for production enhancement during the First Phase of the Green Revolution in India?
qHi: भारत में हरित क्रांति के पहले चरण के दौरान उत्पादन वृद्धि के लिए मुख्य रूप से किस विशिष्ट फसल को लक्षित किया गया था?
explainEn: The first phase of the Green Revolution in India (mid-1960s to mid-1970s) primarily focused on high-yielding varieties of wheat, particularly in northwestern states.

qEn: On which date is Children's Day celebrated in India?
qHi: भारत में बाल दिवस किस तारीख को मनाया जाता है?
optsEn: 14 November is wrong, it is 14 August
optsHi: 14 नवंबर गलत है, यह 14 अगस्त है
explainEn: Children's Day in India is celebrated annually on 14 November, the birth anniversary of Jawaharlal Nehru.

qEn: Whose birth anniversary is commemorated as Children's Day in India?
qHi: भारत में किसकी जयंती को बाल दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है?
explainEn: Children's Day marks the birth anniversary of India's first Prime Minister, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru.

qEn: What was the affectionate nickname given to Jawaharlal Nehru by children?
qHi: बच्चों द्वारा जवाहरलाल नेहरू को दिया गया स्नेहपूर्ण उपनाम क्या था?
explainEn: Jawaharlal Nehru was immensely fond of children and was affectionately known as 'Chacha Nehru' among them.

qEn: Jawaharlal Nehru was the first to hold which office in independent India?
qHi: जवाहरलाल नेहरू स्वतंत्र भारत में किस पद पर आसीन होने वाले पहले व्यक्ति थे?
explainEn: Jawaharlal Nehru served as the first Prime Minister of independent India from 1947 to 1964.

qEn: In which year was Jawaharlal Nehru born?
qHi: जवाहरलाल नेहरू का जन्म किस वर्ष हुआ था?
explainEn: Jawaharlal Nehru was born on 14 November 1889 in Allahabad.

qEn: Which city was the birthplace of Jawaharlal Nehru?
qHi: जवाहरलाल नेहरू का जन्म किस शहर में हुआ था?
explainEn: Jawaharlal Nehru was born in Allahabad (now Prayagraj) in Uttar Pradesh.

qEn: Before 1964, on which date was Children's Day observed in India along with the global community?
qHi: 1964 से पहले, भारत में वैश्विक समुदाय के साथ बाल दिवस किस तारीख को मनाया जाता था?
explainEn: Prior to Jawaharlal Nehru's passing in 1964, India celebrated Children's Day on 20 November, aligning with the United Nations Universal Children's Day.

qEn: Which famous book containing letters to his daughter Indira was written by Jawaharlal Nehru?
qHi: अपनी पुत्री इंदिरा को लिखे गए पत्रों वाला प्रसिद्ध ग्रंथ जवाहरलाल नेहरू द्वारा कौन सा लिखा गया था?
explainEn: 'Glimpses of World History' is a collection of letters written by Jawaharlal Nehru to his young daughter Indira Priyadarshini from various British prisons.

qEn: What was the specific date of birth of Jawaharlal Nehru, which is celebrated as Children's Day in India?
qHi: जवाहरलाल नेहरू की जन्म तिथि क्या है, जिसे भारत में बाल दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है?
explainEn: Children's Day is celebrated annually on November 14 to mark the birth anniversary of India's first Prime Minister.

qEn: By what affectionate nickname by children was Jawaharlal Nehru commonly known during his lifetime?
qHi: अपने जीवनकाल में जवाहरलाल नेहरू को बच्चों द्वारा किस स्नेहपूर्ण उपनाम से जाना जाता था?
explainEn: Nehru had immense love for children, and they fondly called him 'Chacha Nehru'.

qEn: Which specific flower was Jawaharlal Nehru frequently seen wearing in the buttonhole of his jacket, often associated with his fondness for children and nature?
